j-dinosaur-land.name: Dinosaur Land
j-dinosaur-land.parentQuestion: If you could keep one dinosaur as a pet, which one?
j-dinosaur-land.galLine: Dinosaurs are a premier preschool passion; framing them as peaceful, sun-warmed plant-eaters keeps the mood completely safe, wonder-filled, and bedtime-friendly with zero predatory scare!
j-dinosaur-land.parentNote:
Long ago, giant creatures walked under warm green trees.
Look at the tall long-neck dinosaur stretching up to the sky!
And here comes a three-horned friend stomping softly on the moss.
They loved to eat leaves and bask in the warm sunshine.

j-brachiosaurus.name: Brachiosaurus
j-brachiosaurus.parentQuestion: How tall would it be next to our house?
j-brachiosaurus.galLine: Provides an unmistakable, delightful scale comparison next to a familiar house; herbivore smile and cozy cottage keep the giant creature comforting and awe-inspiring!
j-brachiosaurus.parentNote:
Stretch up tall! The Brachiosaurus has the longest neck of all.
Look at how tall it is next to the little house!
It can reach right up into the green treetops for the sweetest leaves.
Munch, crunch! It chews its leafy lunch with a gentle, friendly smile.

j-triceratops.name: Triceratops
j-triceratops.parentQuestion: What do you think the horns were for?
j-triceratops.galLine: A beloved, sturdy four-legged dinosaur whose horns are framed as playful crowns for nudging flowers rather than weapons, ensuring zero intimidation!
j-triceratops.parentNote:
Stomp, stomp, stomp! Here is the sturdy, friendly Triceratops.
It wears a big round frill like a crown and three blunt horns on its nose.
Sniff, sniff! It nudges a clump of soft pink jungle flowers.
Its four strong legs carry it slowly across the sunny clearing.

j-trex.name: T. rex
j-trex.parentQuestion: Why do you think its arms were so small?
j-trex.galLine: Transforms the famously ferocious predator into an endearing, smiling giant with funny little arms; strictly adheres to the "wow, not scary" tone guard for 3-and-4-year-olds!
j-trex.parentNote:
Stomp, stomp, stomp! Here comes the big, friendly Tyrannosaurus rex.
Look at its two tiny arms—they are much smaller than yours!
It has strong green legs for stomping through the tall ferns.
Roar? No, it gives a warm, rumbling dinosaur chuckle!

j-pterosaur.name: Pterosaur
j-pterosaur.parentQuestion: Was this a bird or something else?
j-pterosaur.galLine: Celebrates the dream of flight; framing the flying reptile with wide friendly eyes and glider-like graceful movement keeps the sky creature whimsical and non-threatening!
j-pterosaur.parentNote:
Soar, swoop, glide! Look up in the bright blue prehistoric sky.
The flying reptile spreads its smooth leather wings wide.
With a long beak and a playful crest, it catches the warm breeze.
It banks gently over the treetops like a prehistoric glider!

j-baby-dinosaurs.name: Baby Dinosaurs
j-baby-dinosaurs.parentQuestion: Did dinosaurs have babies like birds do?
j-baby-dinosaurs.galLine: Hatching animal babies provides the highest level of wonder and nurturing connection for 3-and-4-year-olds; joyful, smiling baby reptilian expression removes any trace of scariness!
j-baby-dinosaurs.parentNote:
Crack, crack, peep! A tiny baby dinosaur is peeking out into the world.
It pushed through its big eggshell with a happy green smile.
All around it in the cozy fern nest, more smooth eggs rest safely in the sun.
Welcome to the big green forest, little dinosaur!

j-fossil-dig.name: Fossil Dig
j-fossil-dig.parentQuestion: How do we know dinosaurs were real?
j-fossil-dig.galLine: Connects pretend sand-table play with real paleontology; hands-on discovery tools demystify how we know dinosaurs existed without complex scientific lectures!
j-fossil-dig.parentNote:
Dig, brush, discover! Deep in the sandy earth, ancient treasures are hiding.
These are real dinosaur bones from long, long ago!
A soft bristle brush sweeps away the gentle sand grains.
And a little hand trowel scoops the dirt so we can see the giant bone!

k-construction-in-town.name: Construction in Town
k-construction-in-town.parentQuestion: How do you build something taller than a tree?
k-construction-in-town.galLine: Combines the top intense interest of 3-to-4-year-olds (big yellow work trucks and cranes) in a constructive, community-building context with no noise or hazard anxiety!
k-construction-in-town.parentNote:
Listen to the busy town! The workers are building something new.
A bright yellow dump truck rolls across the sandy ground.
High above the roofs, a tall crane swings its hook.
Brick by brick, a brand new house is growing!

k-dump-truck.name: Dump Truck
k-dump-truck.parentQuestion: Where does all the dirt go?
k-dump-truck.galLine: Tipping and dumping is the single most rewarding mechanical action for toddlers and preschoolers; tactile, satisfying, and completely free of frightening noise!
k-dump-truck.parentNote:
Rumble, rumble! The big yellow dump truck is hard at work.
Its giant black tires roll right over the dirt, rocks, and mud.
Look at the heavy truck bed tilting up toward the sky!
Whoosh! Out slides a mountain of smooth, round brown earth.

k-crane.name: Construction Crane
k-crane.parentQuestion: How does a crane lift something so heavy?
k-crane.galLine: Celebrates sheer height and the magic of lifting heavy things with pulleys; framed securely from ground level with zero vertigo fear!
k-crane.parentNote:
Reach, reach, reach—all the way up into the sky!
The tall yellow crane is strong and steady.
Its steel arm holds a heavy cable and a big hook.
Look down below: the builders are stacking red bricks to make a new house!

k-excavator.name: Excavator
k-excavator.parentQuestion: How deep do you think it can dig?
k-excavator.galLine: The #1 sandbox play fantasy brought to life; compares the excavator's mechanical joints to human shoulder, elbow, and wrist for intuitive physical engagement!
k-excavator.parentNote:
Scoop, lift, dump! The excavator has a long bending arm just like yours.
At the very end is a big metal bucket with strong teeth.
It reaches deep into the ground and scoops up a giant mouthful of dirt!
Then it turns its whole body around to pour the dirt into a neat pile.

k-cement-mixer.name: Cement Mixer
k-cement-mixer.galLine: The spinning barrel is a classic toddler visual magnet; compares mixing cement to stirring kitchen batter to make everyday construction engineering accessible and fun!
k-cement-mixer.parentNote:
Spin, spin, swirl! The yellow cement mixer truck has a giant round drum on its back.
Round and round it turns so the wet cement stays smooth and doesn't get hard!
Inside, sand, water, and little pebbles mix like a big batch of pancake batter.
When the drum tilts back, out flows fresh gray mortar to hold the bricks together!

k-bulldozer.name: Bulldozer
k-bulldozer.galLine: Powerful machine action framed constructively around clearing soil and nurturing young saplings; crawler tracks offer mesmerizing tactile mechanical fascination for 4-year-olds!
k-bulldozer.parentNote:
Push, push, push! The mighty yellow bulldozer rolls on steel caterpillar tracks.
In front, it lowers a giant curved steel blade.
It pushes a big wave of rich brown earth smooth and flat.
Look, it is making a safe, level bed so a little sapling can grow!

k-road-roller.name: Road Roller
k-road-roller.parentQuestion: What does the big roller do to the road?
k-road-roller.galLine: The simple, rhythmic concept of rolling bumpy ground flat provides sensory satisfaction and clear cause-and-effect understanding for young toddlers!
k-road-roller.parentNote:
Roll, roll, roll! Here comes the heavy road roller trundling along the lane.
Its giant, smooth steel drum rolls right over the bumpy dirt.
Squish, squash! It presses the ground flat and smooth so new cars can drive safely.
Rolling along, slow and steady, making a brand new road for everyone!

l-under-the-sea.name: Under the Sea
l-under-the-sea.parentQuestion: What do you think lives in the ocean?
l-under-the-sea.galLine: Warm, sunlit underwater setting with friendly, smiling sea creatures provides pure sensory delight with zero deep-ocean fear or predatory danger!
l-under-the-sea.parentNote:
Splash! The warm blue ocean is full of wonder.
A giant gentle whale glides through the sunny water above.
Down on the reef, a friendly little octopus wiggles its arms.
And look—a green sea turtle is swimming right past to say hello!

l-whale.name: Whale
l-whale.parentQuestion: Is a whale bigger than a school bus?
l-whale.galLine: Awe-inspiring scale without intimidation; comparing the gentle giant to a friendly yellow fish grounds the immense size in playful companionship!
l-whale.parentNote:
The whale is the biggest animal in the whole world!
Even though it is as big as a school bus, it swims very softly.
It hums deep ocean songs that travel for miles under the waves.
A tiny yellow fish swims alongside its giant, gentle friend.

l-octopus.name: Octopus
l-octopus.parentQuestion: What would you do with eight arms?
l-octopus.galLine: Transforms an alien sea creature into a friendly, relatable companion; counting 8 tentacles supports early numeracy in a warm, giggly way!
l-octopus.parentNote:
Peek-a-boo! A clever little octopus is sitting right on its coral rock.
Can you count its wavy arms? One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!
Each arm has soft round suction cups that can hold onto pebbles.
It smiles warmly as golden sunbeams shine down through the clear water.

l-sea-turtle.name: Sea Turtle
l-sea-turtle.parentQuestion: Where do baby turtles come from?
l-sea-turtle.galLine: One of the most calming, universally beloved animal motifs; slow, rhythmic swimming motions promote relaxation and mindful breathing during bedtime play!
l-sea-turtle.parentNote:
Glide, glide, glide... the gentle sea turtle swims like a bird in the water.
Its front flippers flap slowly up and down like strong green wings.
Look at the pretty geometric pattern on its smooth shell!
It swims peacefully through the warm ocean shallows, looking for green seagrass.

l-coral-reef.name: Coral Reef
l-coral-reef.parentQuestion: Why do you think the reef is so colorful?
l-coral-reef.galLine: A riot of joyful colors and friendly swimming fish; transforms an intricate biological ecosystem into a cozy, welcoming fairy-tale playground with no scary predators!
l-coral-reef.parentNote:
Welcome to the underwater rainbow garden!
The coral reef looks like magic rocks, but it is built by millions of tiny living creatures.
Bright orange fish swim between wavy branching corals and soft pink sponges.
It is a safe, sunny home for all the little creatures of the sea.

l-clownfish.name: Clownfish
l-clownfish.galLine: Instantly recognizable and loved by preschoolers; the anemone is framed as a soft, ticklish bed that protects the little fish, turning marine biology into a bedtime snuggle!
l-clownfish.parentNote:
Wiggle, peek, swim! A bright orange clownfish peeks out from its safe coral home.
It has three bold white stripes and round fins that flutter like little fans.
The clownfish lives inside the soft, wavy tentacles of a pink sea anemone.
The anemone tickles and hugs the clownfish, keeping it safe and cozy all day long!

l-seahorse.name: Seahorse
l-seahorse.parentQuestion: Which way is the seahorse facing?
l-seahorse.galLine: A horse-faced sea creature that swims upright with a curly tail creates instant storybook delight and gentle fascination for preschoolers!
l-seahorse.parentNote:
Look at the magical little seahorse floating upright in the coral reef!
Its head is shaped just like a friendly little pony, with a sweet, gentle snout.
Its tail curls into a tight, cozy spiral to hold onto soft coral branches.
Flutter, flutter—its tiny back fin buzzes like a little hummingbird wing!

l-dolphin.name: Dolphin
l-dolphin.parentQuestion: Can a dolphin jump higher than you?
l-dolphin.galLine: A smiling, graceful dolphin gliding through sun-drenched tropical waters embodies pure marine joy, companionship, and boundless wonder!
l-dolphin.parentNote:
Leap and glide! A playful dolphin swims through the warm, sunny ocean.
Its smooth gray back catches the golden sunbeams shining down through the waves.
With a happy open-mouth smile, it sweeps its curved tail up and down.
Look at the tiny yellow fish swimming below—everyone loves to play in the reef!

l-tide-pool.name: Tide pool
l-tide-pool.parentQuestion: What's in the water left behind at the beach?
l-tide-pool.galLine: Discovering a friendly sea star and seashell in a shallow beach puddle connects directly to hands-on coastal shoreline exploration for young kids!
l-tide-pool.parentNote:
When the big ocean waves roll back, they leave behind a sunny little tide pool on the beach!
Resting on the golden sand, a cheerful orange sea star smiles up through the water.
It has five bumpy arms that hug the sand with tiny, gentle suction feet.
A pretty spiral seashell rests nearby in the clear, sparkling water.

m-bug-garden.name: Bug Garden
m-bug-garden.parentQuestion: How many bugs do you think live in our yard?
m-bug-garden.galLine: A magical shift to ground level that turns backyards into fairy-tale kingdoms; features universally loved, non-threatening garden creatures!
m-bug-garden.parentNote:
Down in the mossy grass, tiny creatures are busy at work!
A bright red ladybug crawls across a fresh green leaf.
On a twig, a butterfly rests its delicate velvet wings.
And under that round sandy hill, hundreds of little ants are digging tunnels!

m-butterfly.name: Butterfly
m-butterfly.parentQuestion: Was a butterfly always a butterfly?
m-butterfly.galLine: Delicate, peaceful, and joyful; "flap flap" mimicry is a natural favorite for 3-and-4-year-olds with zero threat or startle response!
m-butterfly.parentNote:
Flap, flap, flutter! A beautiful pale butterfly rests quietly on a green leaf.
Its soft wings look like delicate painted silk.
When it warms its wings in the morning sunshine, it opens and closes them very slowly.
Then off it glides through the garden, floating like a dancing petal!

m-ladybug.name: Ladybug
m-ladybug.parentQuestion: Why do you think it has spots?
m-ladybug.galLine: One of the gentlest, most beloved bugs in early childhood; spot counting supports early numeracy, and the charming garden flower reinforces peaceful backyard exploration!
m-ladybug.parentNote:
Tiptoe, tiptoe! A round little ladybug climbs carefully up a shiny green leaf.
It has a bright red shell with glossy black polka dots.
Can you count the spots on its back? One, two, three, four, five!
Underneath its hard red wings are soft, clear wings that help it fly away home!

m-caterpillar.name: Caterpillar
m-caterpillar.galLine: A plump, smiling caterpillar munching peacefully on a leaf is the quintessential preschool introduction to metamorphosis and life cycles!
m-caterpillar.parentNote:
Wiggle, crawl, inch! A friendly green caterpillar takes tiny steps across a fresh leaf.
Its round, segmented body scrunches together and stretches out long again.
Munch, munch, munch—it loves to nibble on tender greens in the warm sunshine.
One day soon, it will build a cozy chrysalis and wake up with colorful butterfly wings!

m-bee.name: Bee
m-bee.galLine: A gentle, fuzzy bumblebee peacefully sipping nectar from a bright yellow flower replaces sting anxiety with cozy, gentle garden appreciation!
m-bee.parentNote:
Buzz, buzz, buzz! A fuzzy little honeybee lands softly on a bright yellow flower.
Its round body has cozy stripes of golden yellow and velvety black.
With tiny, tickly feet, it sips sweet flower nectar in the warm sunshine.
Soon, it will fly back to the hive to share sweet honey with all its friends!

m-ant-hill.name: Ant Hill
m-ant-hill.galLine: Reveals the hidden wonder of teamwork and underground homes right under our feet; cozy storybook cutaway avoids bugs crawling on the viewer and keeps everything orderly and cheerful!
m-ant-hill.parentNote:
Look what is hiding beneath the garden dirt!
A bustling underground city made of smooth, cozy tunnels and little rooms.
Tiny brown ants march along the pathways, working together as a big family.
One carries a crunchy bread crumb, and another rolls a sunflower seed into the pantry!

m-snail.name: Snail
m-snail.parentQuestion: Where does a snail go when it hides?
m-snail.galLine: The slow, unhurried pace of a friendly snail carrying its house provides a wonderfully calming, unhurried rhythm that is ideal for bedtime unwinding!
m-snail.parentNote:
Slide, glide, slow and steady! A friendly garden snail journeys across a green leaf.
It carries a wonderful round spiral shell on its back like a little round house.
Two long, gentle eye stalks reach up high to see where the morning sun shines best.
Wherever it goes, it leaves a smooth, sparkling silver ribbon along the garden path!

n-train.name: Train
n-train.parentQuestion: Where do you think this train is going?
n-train.galLine: Trains are a core preschool comfort vehicle; gentle rolling landscape and rhythmic chuffing create a soothing, joyful bedtime journey!
n-train.parentNote:
Choo-choo! Here comes the train rolling down the shining rails.
Puffing soft white steam into the summer sky, it chugs past green hills.
Look at the colorful cars carrying friends to new places.
Clickity-clack, clickity-clack, all the way home!

n-airplane.name: Airplane
n-airplane.parentQuestion: How does something so heavy stay up?
n-airplane.galLine: Captures the universal magic of looking up at planes in the sky; friendly cartoonish proportions and sunny skies prevent any fear of heights or turbulence!
n-airplane.parentNote:
Zoom! Up in the wide blue sky, a friendly white airplane is flying.
It has bright yellow wings and a row of round windows for travelers to look out.
High above the green hills and trees, it glides smoothly between puffy white clouds.
Where do you think the airplane is flying today?

n-rocket.name: Rocket
n-rocket.galLine: Channeling space exploration through bedtime wonder and stardust rather than explosive mechanical noise; perfectly links the bedroom window sky to outer space!
n-rocket.parentNote:
Three, two, one... blast off!
A silver and red rocket zooms up through the evening air.
Leaving a glittering golden trail of stardust, it heads toward the moon.
Higher and higher, all the way to the twinkling stars!

o-clouds.name: Clouds
o-clouds.parentQuestion: What do you see in that cloud?
o-clouds.galLine: Cloud gazing is a classic imaginative game for 3-to-4-year-olds; finding animal shapes in clouds builds creative observation and calm, mindful relaxation!
o-clouds.parentNote:
Lie back on the warm green grass and look up at the sky!
What shapes do you see in the drifting clouds?
Look right in the middle—that fluffy white cloud looks just like a bunny rabbit!
It has two tall puffy ears and a round, soft nose.

o-snow.name: Snow
o-snow.parentQuestion: Why is snow cold and white?
o-snow.galLine: A magical, peaceful winter wonderland modeled on Kelowna winters; warmth from the glowing cabin and friendly snowman ensures zero cold or isolation discomfort!
o-snow.parentNote:
Shh... winter has arrived with a blanket of quiet white snow.
Look at the happy snowman standing outside in his warm red scarf!
A wooden sled sits ready at the top of the smooth hill.
High in the night sky, dancing ribbons of northern lights glow green and purple.

o-rainbow.name: Rainbow
o-rainbow.galLine: Rainbows are a peak delight for preschoolers; puddle stomping and bright colors provide gentle, comforting natural science after rain!
o-rainbow.parentNote:
The rain has stopped, and the sun is peeking out through the clouds!
Look up—a giant colorful rainbow stretches from hill to hill.
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple shine brightly.
Look down at the street: the puddles are catching the rainbow colors too!

p-animal-babies.name: Animal Babies
p-animal-babies.galLine: Gal's ideal nurture-and-family theme; seeing gentle mothers caring for their babies provides emotional grounding, security, and animal recognition for young toddlers!
p-animal-babies.parentNote:
Out in the sunlit green pasture, animal families stay close together.
A fluffy white mother sheep watches over her sweet little lamb.
Quack, quack! A mother duck leads two fuzzy yellow ducklings through the grass.
Everyone is safe and cozy in the warm afternoon sun.

d-fish.name: Fish
d-fish.parentQuestion: What do you think this fish is looking for?
d-fish.galLine: A calm, peaceful companion to the frog terrarium; exploring pond life up close is instantly relatable and soothing before bedtime!
d-fish.parentNote:
Down below the lily pads, a shiny golden fish swims through the cool pond.
It wiggles its tail to glide forward, and turns with its soft fins.
Water bubbles float upward toward the sunny surface.
Swimming in the clear pond water feels like flying in the sky!

d-horse-and-foal.name: Horse and Foal
d-horse-and-foal.parentQuestion: Who does the little horse stay close to?
d-horse-and-foal.galLine: Warm maternal animal bonding is deeply comforting to a 4-year-old; clear silhouettes allow easy finger taps for both the big horse and the little foal with no scary elements!
d-horse-and-foal.parentNote:
Across the sunny field, a mother horse stands with her little foal.
They have soft golden coats and fluffy manes that catch the breeze.
The baby foal stays close beside its mother's side.
Together, they trot through the tall grass and sniff the sweet yellow flowers.

d-bird-and-nest.name: Bird and Nest
d-bird-and-nest.parentQuestion: How many eggs are in the nest?
d-bird-and-nest.galLine: Observing bird eggs and gentle nesting satisfies early natural curiosity about where baby birds come from, framed safely and warmly!
d-bird-and-nest.parentNote:
High up in the leafy green tree, a songbird sits beside her cozy nest.
The nest is woven carefully from dry twigs, moss, and soft grass.
Inside rest three smooth, speckled eggs, kept warm and safe.
Soon, tiny baby birds will hatch and sing their very first song!

p-bunny-babies.name: Bunny Babies
p-bunny-babies.parentQuestion: How do baby bunnies stay warm in the grass?
p-bunny-babies.galLine: A heartwarming mother-and-baby bunny portrait that provides emotional security and tenderness; ideal for Gal (age 3) and young preschoolers learning animal families.
p-bunny-babies.parentNote: Hop, hop, wiggle! A gentle mother rabbit sits in the warm sunny grass.

p-calf.name: Calf
p-calf.parentQuestion: What does a baby cow say to its mama?
p-calf.galLine: The mother-and-baby cow pairing highlights familial care and gentle nurture; friendly facial expressions and soft golden lighting ensure total comfort and warmth.
p-calf.parentNote: Out in the sunlit golden pasture, a mother cow looks lovingly at her little calf.

p-goslings.name: Goslings
p-goslings.parentQuestion: Why do the little goslings follow their mother in a line?
p-goslings.galLine: Following in a line is a familiar preschool routine (duck-duck-goose, preschool walking lines); seeing goslings follow their mother brings joy, structure, and emotional comfort.
p-goslings.parentNote: Honk, honk! Mother goose leads the way across the golden meadow.

p-piglets.name: Piglets
p-piglets.parentQuestion: Why do piglets love to wiggle their curly tails?
p-piglets.galLine: A classic counting and nursery animal joy; four cheerful pink piglets and a smiling mother pig offer rich counting opportunities and pure preschool giggles.
p-piglets.parentNote: Oink, oink! A happy mother pig smiles in the warm sunny grass.

p-puppies-kittens.name: Puppies and Kittens
p-puppies-kittens.parentQuestion: Do puppies and kittens like to take naps together?
p-puppies-kittens.galLine: Puppies and kittens playing peacefully together is an irresistible preschool favorite; soft fur, gentle postures, and mutual affection model friendly friendship and cooperative play.
p-puppies-kittens.parentNote: Look who is playing together in the warm afternoon sunshine!

o-kite-wind.name: Windy Day Kite
o-kite-wind.parentQuestion: What makes the kite fly up into the sky?
o-kite-wind.galLine: Flying a kite embodies pure kinetic joy; viewing the soaring kite and dancing ribbons introduces preschoolers to the invisible power of wind in a gentle, delightful way.
o-kite-wind.parentNote: Whoosh! Feel the fresh, breezy wind blowing across the grassy hill.

o-morning-fog.name: Morning Fog
o-morning-fog.parentQuestion: Where do you think the trees hide when the fog rolls in?
o-morning-fog.galLine: Morning fog can sometimes feel spooky if dark, but here the warm sunshine and pillow-soft hills make it feel like nature wrapping the earth in a cozy bedtime quilt.
o-morning-fog.parentNote: Peek outside! A soft, cozy blanket of white fog fills the peaceful green valleys.

o-thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
o-thunderstorm.parentQuestion: What do the clouds sound like when they roll together?
o-thunderstorm.galLine: Storms can intimidate young children, so framing rain as a sun-warmed, nurturing sunshower with a cozy cottage removes all fear and emphasizes cozy shelter and soothing sounds.
o-thunderstorm.parentNote: Pitter, patter, tap! A warm summer shower is falling over the green hills.

o-sunrise.name: Sunrise
o-sunrise.parentQuestion: What wakes up first when the sun comes up?
o-sunrise.galLine: A calm, uplifting start-of-day vista; gentle morning colors and a friendly sunrise offer reassurance, security, and a peaceful transition from bedtime to daytime play.
o-sunrise.parentNote: Good morning, world! The warm golden sun is peeking up over the green hills.

o-sunset.name: Sunset
o-sunset.parentQuestion: Where does the sun go to sleep at night?
o-sunset.galLine: A deeply soothing, bedtime-aligned sunset filled with warm, reassuring colors; ideal for winding down before sleep with zero darkness or loneliness.
o-sunset.parentNote: The sun is getting sleepy, slowly sinking down behind the gentle rolling hills.

o-puddles.name: Rain Puddles
o-puddles.parentQuestion: What makes big splashes when you jump in puddles?
o-puddles.galLine: Splashing in puddles and looking at reflections is an elemental preschool joy; this tranquil, sunlit scene celebrates post-rain freshness with zero mud or gloom.
o-puddles.parentNote: The summer rain has stopped, leaving a wonderful, shiny puddle right in the grass!

o-spring-flowers.name: Spring Flowers
o-spring-flowers.parentQuestion: How do flowers drink the rain?
o-spring-flowers.galLine: A joyful spring celebration bursting with gentle floral colors, dancing butterflies, and a whimsical cloud bunny that sparks wonder and imaginative observation.
o-spring-flowers.parentNote: Spring is here, and the rolling green hills are blanketed with fresh blooming flowers!

o-beach.name: Summer Beach
o-beach.parentQuestion: What does warm sand feel like under your toes?
o-beach.galLine: A bright, cheerful summer sensory haven; familiar sandcastles, buckets, and gentle lapping waves make the beach feel safe, welcoming, and comforting.
o-beach.parentNote: Listen to the gentle ocean waves: whoosh, splash, whoosh!

o-autumn-leaves.name: Autumn Leaves
o-autumn-leaves.parentQuestion: Why do the leaves turn red and golden in autumn?
o-autumn-leaves.galLine: A cozy, sensory-rich autumn scene full of warm colors and gentle motion; the bunny-shaped cloud adds delight and imaginative play without any cold or gloom.
o-autumn-leaves.parentNote: Crunch, crunch, crunch! Look at all the golden leaves covering the rolling hills.

o-snowman.name: Snowman
o-snowman.parentQuestion: What should we use for the snowman's nose?
o-snowman.galLine: Building a snowman is pure winter joy; combining the cheerful smiling character with a warm glowing cottage ensures kids feel completely cozy, safe, and happy.
o-snowman.parentNote: Roll, roll, roll! First a big snowball for the bottom, then a round snowball on top!

o-frost.name: Frost
o-frost.parentQuestion: Who draws the sparkly patterns on the cold window?
o-frost.galLine: Winter frost framed through peaceful, pastel sunrise colors and gentle warmth ensures a soothing, cozy aesthetic without any harsh blizzard or scary freezing sensations.
o-frost.parentNote: The chilly night air has painted the fields in sparkling white frost!

o-dew.name: Morning Dew
o-dew.parentQuestion: Why do grass blades wear tiny water drops in the morning?
o-dew.galLine: A magical micro-view of a familiar morning phenomenon; oversized sparkling drops and cheerful daisies turn a simple lawn into a wonder-filled sensory treasure hunt.
o-dew.parentNote: Good morning, little garden! The grass is covered in hundreds of tiny water drops.

k-front-loader.name: Front Loader
k-front-loader.parentQuestion: How much dirt can the big scoop lift at once?
k-front-loader.galLine: Big wheels and giant scoops are universally loved by 3-to-5-year-olds; scooping dirt taps right into intuitive sandbox play.
k-front-loader.parentNote: Vroom, chug, chug! The big yellow front loader is ready for hard work.

k-forklift.name: Forklift
k-forklift.parentQuestion: How high can the forklift lift that heavy crate?
k-forklift.galLine: A friendly driver and visible lifting mechanics make heavy machinery feel helpful, approachable, and fun for vehicle-loving preschoolers.
k-forklift.parentNote: Beep, beep! Here comes the little yellow forklift rolling across the work yard.

k-water-truck.name: Water Truck
k-water-truck.parentQuestion: Why does the water truck spray the dusty road?
k-water-truck.galLine: Water spraying from a truck is a delightful, sensory everyday wonder that transforms dusty work into a refreshing and playful community helper moment.
k-water-truck.parentNote: Swoosh, spray! Here comes the friendly blue water truck rolling along the path.

k-wheelbarrow.name: Wheelbarrow
k-wheelbarrow.parentQuestion: What would you carry in your little wheelbarrow?
k-wheelbarrow.galLine: Pushing a wheelbarrow full of dirt is a favorite active garden chore that toddlers adore imitating, combining physical exploration with planting and building.
k-wheelbarrow.parentNote: Creak, roll, creak! Here rests a cozy wooden wheelbarrow in the middle of the field.

k-bricks.name: Bricks
k-bricks.parentQuestion: How do so many bricks make a strong house?
k-bricks.galLine: Stacking and building with red blocks or bricks is a cornerstone of early childhood play; framing building materials as constructive and tangible is instantly engaging.
k-bricks.parentNote: Look at all the sturdy red bricks stacked on the wooden pallet!

k-scaffolding.name: Scaffolding
k-scaffolding.parentQuestion: How do the builders climb up so high?
k-scaffolding.galLine: Framing construction scaffolding as a helpful, climbable wooden frame turns building architecture into an intuitive, friendly, step-by-step concept.
k-scaffolding.parentNote: Look at the wooden poles reaching high around the stone house!

k-safety-cones.name: Safety Cones
k-safety-cones.parentQuestion: Why are the safety cones bright orange?
k-safety-cones.galLine: Counting bright orange cones connects safety awareness with basic number practice in an everyday community helper setting.
k-safety-cones.parentNote: One, two, three, four, five! Bright orange safety cones stand in a neat, tidy row.

k-shovel.name: Shovel
k-shovel.parentQuestion: What can you dig up with a shovel in the yard?
k-shovel.galLine: Digging holes with shovels is a quintessential toddler and preschool joy; focusing on the simple, tactile tool encourages imaginative garden and builder play.
k-shovel.parentNote: Dig, dig, scoop! The strong metal shovel is standing right in the soft dirt.

l-crab.name: Crab
l-crab.parentQuestion: Why does the little crab walk sideways on the sand?
l-crab.galLine: A smiling, friendly crab waving its claws on a sunny beach makes coastal crustacean life cheerful, harmless, and tactile for young children.
l-crab.parentNote: Click, clack! A friendly orange crab sits on a warm, smooth stone by the shore.

l-jellyfish.name: Jellyfish
l-jellyfish.parentQuestion: How does a jellyfish float like a soft little parachute?
l-jellyfish.galLine: Framed as a gentle floating pink lantern with zero sting or menace, celebrating calm rhythmic motion and squishy softness.
l-jellyfish.parentNote: Float, float, float! A gentle jellyfish drifts peacefully through the warm sea.

l-pufferfish.name: Pufferfish
l-pufferfish.parentQuestion: Why does the pufferfish puff up like a round balloon?
l-pufferfish.galLine: A cheerful round fish puffing up like a swimming balloon provides pure comedy and physical whimsy, turning a defensive mechanism into a friendly preschool delight.
l-pufferfish.parentNote: Look at this round little fish! It puffed itself up like a friendly yellow balloon.

l-shark.name: Friendly shark
l-shark.parentQuestion: Do gentle sharks have friends under the sea?
l-shark.galLine: Explicitly framed with a sweet smile, rounded features, and companion fish, removing all predatory scare to make sharks friendly and approachable.
l-shark.parentNote: Glide, glide, glide! A friendly, smiling shark cruises peacefully through the sunny ocean.

l-manatee.name: Manatee
l-manatee.parentQuestion: Why do people call the manatee a gentle sea cow?
l-manatee.galLine: The manatee's chubby, slow-moving shape and gentle herbivore nature make it an instant bedtime favorite that embodies calm, peaceful movement.
l-manatee.parentNote: Here comes the gentle manatee gliding softly through the warm water!

l-sea-otter.name: Sea Otter
l-sea-otter.parentQuestion: Why do sea otters hold hands when they float?
l-sea-otter.galLine: A sea otter floating on its back cradling a favorite seashell is a universally cherished animal behavior that models gentle curiosity and playfulness.
l-sea-otter.parentNote: Splash! A friendly sea otter floats on its back in the gentle ocean waves.

l-kelp-forest.name: Kelp Forest
l-kelp-forest.parentQuestion: Who plays hide-and-seek in the tall kelp trees?
l-kelp-forest.galLine: A baby sea otter snuggling safely in a kelp blanket illustrates how sea creatures rest and stay safe, offering pure comfort and cozy reassurance.
l-kelp-forest.parentNote: High above the seabed, tall green kelp plants reach toward the sun like an underwater forest!

l-sea-slug.name: Sea Slug
l-sea-slug.parentQuestion: Why are sea slugs so brightly colored like little ribbons?
l-sea-slug.galLine: Framed as an adorable, fancy creature wearing a ruffled dress, this introduces soft marine biodiversity with zero ick-factor.
l-sea-slug.parentNote: Meet the fanciest little creature on the reef—a colorful sea slug!

l-hermit-crab.name: Hermit crab
l-hermit-crab.parentQuestion: How does the hermit crab find a new shell when it grows?
l-hermit-crab.galLine: Carrying a cozy "house on your back" is an intuitive, comforting concept that preschoolers relate directly to blankets, forts, and security.
l-hermit-crab.parentNote: Peek-a-boo! A tiny, cheerful hermit crab peeks out of its cozy spiral shell.

m-beetle.name: Beetle
m-beetle.parentQuestion: Why is the beetle's shell as shiny as an emerald?
m-beetle.galLine: Portraying beetles as shiny, friendly jewel-bugs crawling gently on leaves encourages gentle curiosity and hands-on nature discovery.
m-beetle.parentNote: Click-click! A shiny little emerald beetle crawls across a broad green leaf.

m-dragonfly.name: Dragonfly
m-dragonfly.parentQuestion: How fast can a dragonfly zip over the water?
m-dragonfly.galLine: Comparing dragonfly flight to a friendly miniature helicopter makes insect aerodynamics fascinating and fun for young vehicle and nature enthusiasts.
m-dragonfly.parentNote: Zoom, hover, land! A shimmering turquoise dragonfly rests on a wide green leaf.

m-fireflies.name: Fireflies
m-fireflies.parentQuestion: How do fireflies turn on their little night-lights?
m-fireflies.galLine: Gentle blinking fireflies are an iconic bedtime comfort image, turning the evening dark into a magical, welcoming world of tiny nightlights.
m-fireflies.parentNote: Blink, twinkle, glow! Tiny friendly fireflies dance over the garden moss.

m-grasshopper.name: Grasshopper
m-grasshopper.parentQuestion: How far can a grasshopper leap in one big jump?
m-grasshopper.galLine: Jumping like a grasshopper is a favorite physical action for preschoolers; the big friendly eyes and folded legs turn biomechanics into intuitive leaping play.
m-grasshopper.parentNote: Boing! A bright green grasshopper sits perched on a sunny garden leaf.

m-moth.name: Moth
m-moth.parentQuestion: Why do moths like to flutter around soft evening lights?
m-moth.galLine: A cuddly, fuzzy moth with soft cream wings and a friendly smiling face makes nocturnal insects feel as gentle and sweet as a plush bedtime toy.
m-moth.parentNote: Flutter, flutter! A soft, fuzzy silk moth rests gently on a green leaf.

m-pill-bug.name: Pill bug
m-pill-bug.parentQuestion: Why does the pill bug roll into a tiny round ball?
m-pill-bug.galLine: Rolling up into a ball like a roly-poly is one of the most celebrated hands-on discoveries of early childhood, turning armor into delightful curling play.
m-pill-bug.parentNote: Tickle, crawl, roll! Here comes a friendly little pill bug out for a walk.

m-spider-web.name: Spider web
m-spider-web.parentQuestion: How does a spider weave such a delicate web?
m-spider-web.galLine: Framing the spider web as a beautiful dewy lace necklace crafted by a tiny smiling weaver removes fear and highlights natural pattern appreciation.
m-spider-web.parentNote: Glisten, shine! Between two green branches hangs a magical woven web.

m-worm.name: Worm
m-worm.parentQuestion: How do earthworms help the garden soil grow flowers?
m-worm.galLine: A smiling earthworm popping up to greet a ladybug turns garden soil ecology into a charming, friendly peer conversation.
m-worm.parentNote: Pop! Up from the rich, crumbly garden soil pops a happy pink earthworm!

m-chrysalis.name: Chrysalis
m-chrysalis.parentQuestion: What is resting quietly inside the golden chrysalis?
m-chrysalis.galLine: A quiet, sleeping cocoon hanging safely in the sun teaches gentle patience and the cozy transformation of growing up.
m-chrysalis.parentNote: Shh... hanging from a tender twig hangs a golden chrysalis.

j-giant-fern.name: Giant Fern
j-giant-fern.parentQuestion: How tall was the giant fern tree back in dinosaur times?
j-giant-fern.galLine: Giant plants provide an imaginative shift in perspective that delights preschoolers through scale and natural beauty without any scary creatures.
j-giant-fern.parentNote: Look how tall the green ferns grow in the dinosaur forest!

j-ginkgo-shade.name: Ginkgo Tree
j-ginkgo-shade.parentQuestion: Do you like the fan-shaped ginkgo leaves?
j-ginkgo-shade.galLine: A sleeping baby dinosaur resting peacefully in a leafy tree nook is a classic bedtime comfort image, reinforcing security, rest, and cozy protection.
j-ginkgo-shade.parentNote: Under the branches of the ancient Ginkgo tree, cool green shade keeps the afternoon quiet.

j-volcano.name: Volcano
j-volcano.parentQuestion: Can you see the gentle smoke drifting from the distant mountain?
j-volcano.galLine: Framing the volcano as a calm, steaming mountain in the distance satisfies geology curiosity while strictly avoiding scary fire, explosions, or lava peril.
j-volcano.parentNote: Far across the green valley rises a grand, ancient mountain.

j-ankylosaurus.name: Ankylosaurus
j-ankylosaurus.parentQuestion: Why does this dinosaur have a round club on its tail?
j-ankylosaurus.galLine: Framing the armored dinosaur with a friendly smile and gentle tail wag keeps prehistoric armor fascinating and completely non-threatening for preschoolers.
j-ankylosaurus.parentNote: Stomp, stomp, stomp! Here comes a friendly armored Ankylosaurus walking down the sunny path.

j-stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
j-stegosaurus.parentQuestion: Look at the kite-shaped plates along its back!
j-stegosaurus.galLine: A friendly smiling expression and sun-catching plates make this iconic dinosaur familiar, approachable, and comforting for preschool exploration.
j-stegosaurus.parentNote: Here comes the Stegosaurus walking proudly along the sunny trail!

j-watering-hole.name: Watering Hole
j-watering-hole.parentQuestion: Who is coming down to the cool water for a drink?
j-watering-hole.galLine: A calm watering hole where prehistoric friends drink together side-by-side reinforces gentle companionship, sharing, and peaceful nature observation.
j-watering-hole.parentNote: In the middle of the green forest lies a cool, still pond.

j-duckbill.name: Duckbill
j-duckbill.parentQuestion: Why does this gentle dinosaur have a beak like a duck?
j-duckbill.galLine: The friendly smiling expression, soft rounded duck bill, and gentle herbivore framing keep this dinosaur approachable, endearing, and toddler-safe.

j-tiny-dinosaur.name: Tiny Dinosaur
j-tiny-dinosaur.parentQuestion: Is this little dinosaur smaller than a chicken?
j-tiny-dinosaur.galLine: Showing that some dinosaurs were tiny and pocket-sized creates an instant endearing connection for young children who love small baby animals.
j-tiny-dinosaur.parentNote: Not all dinosaurs were as big as a house—look at this tiny little friend!

j-dino-eggs.name: Dinosaur Eggs
j-dino-eggs.parentQuestion: What is sleeping inside those round speckled eggs?
j-dino-eggs.galLine: Safe, cozy nest with unhatched speckled eggs inspires gentle anticipation and wonder about baby dinosaurs without any scary elements.
j-dino-eggs.parentNote: Tucked safely on the warm forest floor rests a big round nest.

dd-fossil-prep-table.name: Fossil Prep Table
dd-fossil-prep-table.parentQuestion: What tools do scientists use to brush away the dust?
dd-fossil-prep-table.galLine: Hands-on laboratory tools turn dinosaur science into a cozy table-top workshop where young children explore through gentle puzzles, touchable plaster, and magnifying lenses without any scary predator themes.
dd-fossil-prep-table.parentNote: Look at the wooden field table under the sunny canvas tent!

dd-fossil-magnifier.name: Fossil Magnifier
dd-fossil-magnifier.parentQuestion: Look closely at the tiny bumps on the ancient bone!
dd-fossil-magnifier.galLine: Magnifying glasses are an iconic, intuitive preschool investigation tool; looking closely at nature's miniature treasures builds observation and patience.
dd-fossil-magnifier.parentNote: Look through the big glass lens—everything gets huge and clear!

j-dino-tracks.name: Dinosaur Tracks
j-dino-tracks.parentQuestion: Look at those giant footprints stamped in the mud!
j-dino-tracks.galLine: Giant footprints turn tracking into an imaginative, kid-friendly mystery about scale and steps without any predatory danger.
j-dino-tracks.parentNote: Look down at the muddy trail! Someone very big walked right through here.

n-bicycle.name: Bicycle
n-bicycle.parentQuestion: Where would you ride your bicycle on a sunny afternoon?
n-bicycle.galLine: Riding a bicycle with a bell and basket connects directly to early balance bike milestones and joyful neighborhood exploration.
n-bicycle.parentNote: Ring, ring! A lovely green bicycle rests beside the sunny stone path.

n-cable-car.name: Cable Car
n-cable-car.parentQuestion: What can you see from the little red car on the wire?
n-cable-car.galLine: Gliding through the air on a cable wire is exciting yet peaceful; large windows and friendly colors keep the height feeling cozy and safe.
n-cable-car.parentNote: Glide, glide, glide! High above the forest rolls a cheerful red cable car.

n-tram.name: Tram
n-tram.parentQuestion: Where is the cheerful yellow tram rolling today?
n-tram.galLine: A street tram ringing its bell through a cozy village street connects directly to neighborhood transit and friendly community exploration.
n-tram.parentNote: Ding-ding! A sunny yellow street tram rolls smoothly down the middle of the village road.

n-airship.name: Airship
n-airship.parentQuestion: How does the gentle airship float through the clouds?
n-airship.galLine: A calm, slow-floating airship with a wooden boat cabin provides a soothing, dreamy birds-eye perspective of the world below.
n-airship.parentNote: High up in the golden morning sky drifts a grand, gentle airship.

n-helicopter.name: Helicopter
n-helicopter.parentQuestion: How fast do those big rotor blades spin in the sky?
n-helicopter.galLine: Helicopter flight is fascinating for young children; framing the spinning rotors as a gentle, friendly breeze prevents loud mechanical startle responses.
n-helicopter.parentNote: Whir-whir-whir! A cheerful bright red helicopter hovers gently over the green field.

n-hot-air-balloon.name: Hot Air Balloon
n-hot-air-balloon.parentQuestion: What colors do you see on the big floating balloon?
n-hot-air-balloon.galLine: A slow, peaceful hot air balloon floating gently through morning light provides a dreamy, calm bedtime aesthetic for preschoolers.
n-hot-air-balloon.parentNote: Whoosh! Warm air gently fills the giant colorful balloon.

dd-puddle-rainbow-prism.name: Puddle Rainbow Prism
dd-puddle-rainbow-prism.parentQuestion: How many colors shine when sunlight hits the water?
dd-puddle-rainbow-prism.galLine: Connects the giant sky rainbow with concrete, tabletop optics; toddlers love seeing sunlight turn into tangible color stripes on the ground without confusing technical explanations.
dd-puddle-rainbow-prism.parentNote: After the summer shower, sunlight pours down through the wet garden leaves.

dd-snow-crystal-fort.name: Snow Crystal Fort
dd-snow-crystal-fort.parentQuestion: Who built the glowing crystal ice fort?
dd-snow-crystal-fort.galLine: Snow fort play provides the ultimate sense of cozy sanctuary; focuses on tactile winter delights like building, decorating, and viewing delicate snowflake crystals safely out of the wind.
dd-snow-crystal-fort.parentNote: Crawl inside the sparkling white snow fort!

dd-underground-ant-nest.name: Underground Ant Nest
dd-underground-ant-nest.parentQuestion: Look at the busy ants marching through their tunnels!
dd-underground-ant-nest.galLine: Underground cutaway reveals an organized, cozy family home below the grass; familiar nursery and pantry concepts make miniature insect biology completely warm and relatable for preschoolers.
dd-underground-ant-nest.parentNote: Step right under the grass into the secret underground ant home!

dd-builder-workbench.name: Builder Workbench
dd-builder-workbench.parentQuestion: What can you build with the wooden blocks and ruler?
dd-builder-workbench.galLine: Workbench play mirrors toddler toy workbenches and block-building; concrete tools, bricks, and pulleys introduce mechanical cause-and-effect with friendly colors and zero hazards.
dd-builder-workbench.parentNote: Clack, roll, click! Welcome to the builder's sturdy wooden workbench right beside the new building!

dd-tide-pool.name: Tide Pool
dd-tide-pool.parentQuestion: What friendly creatures are swimming in the shallow puddle?
dd-tide-pool.galLine: Tide pools transform the vast, deep ocean into a safe, knee-deep miniature world that preschoolers can reach out and touch; gentle water creatures invite tactile wonder without any fear of waves or deep water.
dd-tide-pool.parentNote: When the big ocean waves roll back, a warm little puddle stays behind on the rocks.

dd-sea-star-rock.name: Sea Star Rock
dd-sea-star-rock.parentQuestion: How many bumpy arms does the orange sea star have?
dd-sea-star-rock.galLine: Shapes and counting ("1, 2, 3, 4, 5 points on the star!"); tactile rock-clinging creatures demystify ocean textures with rounded, friendly forms.

dd-anemone-garden.name: Sea Anemone Garden
dd-anemone-garden.parentQuestion: Do the soft anemone petals tickle like flowers?
dd-anemone-garden.galLine: Swaying anemones feel like an underwater flower garden; seeing a tiny crab use a shell for a house is a delightful, comforting preschool narrative of animal homes.
dd-anemone-garden.parentNote: Look at the waving sea anemones—they look like underwater flowers, but they are gentle sea animals!

dd-pearl-oyster.name: Pearl Oyster
dd-pearl-oyster.parentQuestion: What is hiding inside the shiny seashell?
dd-pearl-oyster.galLine: Finding smooth shells and shiny pebbles on the shore is a classic toddler treasure hunt; pearl and sea glass provide tactile, soothing natural beauty.
dd-pearl-oyster.parentNote: Look down into the sandy hollow: a treasure from the sea!

dd-hermit-crab-shell.name: Hermit Crab Shell
dd-hermit-crab-shell.parentQuestion: How does the hermit crab carry its home on its back?
dd-hermit-crab-shell.galLine: Peak peek-a-boo play mechanics; hermit crabs tucking in and popping out is one of the most endearing, non-threatening animal behaviors for 3-year-olds.

dd-sea-glass-collection.name: Sea Glass Collection
dd-sea-glass-collection.parentQuestion: Where did all the smooth, colorful beach pebbles come from?
dd-sea-glass-collection.galLine: Sorting colors and tactile shapes ("smooth, round, soft"); celebrates sensory collecting and the calming power of water tumbling rough stones into gems.
dd-sea-glass-collection.parentNote: Look at these smooth, magical treasures washed ashore by the gentle waves!

dd-tiny-sea-urchin.name: Tiny Sea Urchin
dd-tiny-sea-urchin.parentQuestion: Look at the round little urchin with its purple spines!
dd-tiny-sea-urchin.galLine: Framing the urchin with soft, blunt rounded spines removes any prickle anxiety; emphasizes gentle animal movement and safe sensory observation.
dd-tiny-sea-urchin.parentNote: Look at this round little ocean friend!

fa-circus-tent.name: Circus Tent
fa-circus-tent.parentQuestion: What fun surprises are waiting inside the big striped tent?
fa-circus-tent.galLine: Celebrates traditional circus joy—music, colors, movement, and festive treats—in a gentle, daytime setting free of loud startling noises, high-altitude peril, or scary clown makeup.
fa-circus-tent.parentNote: Tada! The friendly circus has arrived on the sunlit village green!

fa-circus-ring.name: Circus Ring
fa-circus-ring.parentQuestion: Can you watch the acrobats leap through the ribbons?
fa-circus-ring.galLine: Frames circus performance around cooperation, skill, and gentle physical humor; clowns have warm, natural smiling faces without exaggerated scary masks or jarring gags.
fa-circus-ring.parentNote: Step right into the golden circle of fresh pine sawdust!

fa-circus-carousel.name: Storybook Carousel
fa-circus-carousel.parentQuestion: Which painted pony would you choose to ride on?
fa-circus-carousel.galLine: A cornerstone preschool delight: the gentle, hypnotic rhythm of carousel horses and mechanical music provides soothing, repeatable cause-and-effect interaction.
fa-circus-carousel.parentNote: Round and round spins the magical wooden carousel!

fa-pirate-ship.name: Pirate Ship
fa-pirate-ship.parentQuestion: Where is the friendly ship sailing across the blue sea?
fa-pirate-ship.galLine: Replaces pirate danger with gentle nautical adventure, emphasizing friendly animals, shiny seashells, and sunlit lagoon play without weapons or battles.
fa-pirate-ship.parentNote: Ahoy! A jolly wooden pirate ship bobs gently on calm turquoise water.

fa-pirate-deck.name: Pirate Ship Deck
fa-pirate-deck.parentQuestion: Can you turn the wooden ship wheel to steer?
fa-pirate-deck.galLine: Focuses on the tactile physical delight of steering, climbing, and exploring ship mechanics, turning the galleon into a giant wooden playground.
fa-pirate-deck.parentNote: Step aboard the sun-warmed wooden ship deck!

fa-treasure-island.name: Treasure Island
fa-treasure-island.parentQuestion: What sparkles under the palm tree on the beach?
fa-treasure-island.galLine: Channeling classic treasure hunt excitement into tactile exploration of natural beach treasures—smooth shells, coconuts, and shiny coins—in a safe tropical paradise.
fa-treasure-island.parentNote: The wooden rowboat touches down softly on warm white sand.

fa-toy-shop.name: Toy Shop
fa-toy-shop.parentQuestion: Look at all the cuddly teddy bears in the shop window!
fa-toy-shop.galLine: Connects directly to children's immediate passion for hands-on playthings, framing craftsmanship and pretend play within a calm, warmly lit storybook shop.
fa-toy-shop.parentNote: Step through the warm wooden doorway into the enchanting toy shop!

fa-puppet-show.name: Puppet Show
fa-puppet-show.parentQuestion: What funny story are the little puppets telling today?
fa-puppet-show.galLine: Celebrates dramatic pretend play and storytelling through tangible, child-scale puppets, encouraging imagination and creative roleplay in a secure, comforting room.
fa-puppet-show.parentNote: Shh... the little puppet theater is ready for showtime!

fa-toy-train-table.name: Toy Train Table
fa-toy-train-table.parentQuestion: Where is the wooden train chugging around the wooden tracks?
fa-toy-train-table.galLine: Captures the #1 universal preschool play dynamic: miniature worlds, rolling wheels, and clockwork cause-and-effect that children can mentally manipulate with complete mastery.
fa-toy-train-table.parentNote: All aboard! The wooden toy train table is full of busy little tracks!

fa-friendly-castle.name: Friendly Castle
fa-friendly-castle.parentQuestion: Who lives inside the stone castle on the hill?
fa-friendly-castle.galLine: Transforms the traditional medieval castle into a warm, sunlit, peaceful sanctuary where the dragon is an approachable smiling neighbor and the open gate signals complete safety.
fa-friendly-castle.parentNote: High upon a grassy green hill stands a friendly stone castle with round towers.

fa-castle-courtyard.name: Castle Courtyard
fa-castle-courtyard.parentQuestion: Can you hear the music playing in the courtyard?
fa-castle-courtyard.galLine: Frames castle life as an inviting festival community centered around music, baking, and boating, grounding medieval fantasy in concrete, joyful preschool experiences.
fa-castle-courtyard.parentNote: The cobblestone castle courtyard is bustling with happy festival preparations!

fa-gentle-dragon.name: Gentle Dragon
fa-gentle-dragon.parentQuestion: Did you see the friendly green dragon smile at us?
fa-gentle-dragon.galLine: Completely disarms dragon folklore for 3-to-5-year-olds by turning the creature into an oversized, cuddly domestic companion who drinks mint tea, naps on pillows, and purrs peacefully.
fa-gentle-dragon.parentNote: Meet Barnaby, the gentlest green dragon in the kingdom!

fa-dragon-tea-party.name: Dragon Tea Party
fa-dragon-tea-party.parentQuestion: Would you like a cup of warm tea with the dragon?
fa-dragon-tea-party.galLine: A hilarious and comforting role-reversal: the legendary "fire-breathing" monster sits patiently using dainty tea manners with tiny mouse friends, reinforcing gentleness and social warmth.
fa-dragon-tea-party.parentNote: Tea time is Barnaby the dragon's favorite part of the afternoon!

fa-magic-garden.name: Magic Garden
fa-magic-garden.parentQuestion: What magic grows in this glowing evening garden?
fa-magic-garden.galLine: Connects early childhood delight in sensory exploration—sounds, glows, and tiny fairy worlds—within an utterly benign, sun-warmed natural garden environment.
fa-magic-garden.parentNote: Welcome to the magic garden behind the castle walls!

fa-singing-flowers.name: Singing Flowers
fa-singing-flowers.parentQuestion: What song do the cheerful flowers sing when the wind blows?
fa-singing-flowers.galLine: Encourages auditory and musical imagination through gentle botanical chimes, supporting sensory calm and musical pattern recognition without jarring sounds.
fa-singing-flowers.parentNote: Listen closely! The bell flowers in the magical garden love to sing.

fa-glowing-mushrooms.name: Glowing Mushrooms
fa-glowing-mushrooms.parentQuestion: Look how the soft mushrooms glow in the dark like night-lights!
fa-glowing-mushrooms.galLine: Connects directly to nighttime comfort and nightlights; the soft pulsing glow and sleeping frog reassure children about darkness and nighttime tranquility.
fa-glowing-mushrooms.parentNote: Under the cool green fern leaves grows a family of friendly glowing mushrooms.

fa-baby-dragon-bubbles.name: Baby Dragon Bubbles
fa-baby-dragon-bubbles.parentQuestion: Look at the baby dragon blowing shiny soap bubbles!
fa-baby-dragon-bubbles.galLine: Transforms mythical dragon breathing into the most beloved toddler sensory fascination: catching and popping floating soap bubbles in the sunshine.
fa-baby-dragon-bubbles.parentNote: Look at Pip, the tiny baby dragon playing in the sunny meadow!

gx1-deer-in-the-yard.name: Deer in the Yard
gx1-deer-in-the-yard.parentQuestion: What is the deer looking at?
gx1-deer-in-the-yard.galLine: Gentle wildlife encounter promotes reverence for living creatures with calm, soothing morning atmosphere.
gx1-deer-in-the-yard.parentNote:
Shh... Look who has stepped quietly into the green yard at sunrise!
A gentle brown deer with soft white spots nibbles sweet clover on the lawn.
Its big round ears twitch softly to listen to the birds singing in the trees.
Everything is calm and peaceful in the early morning meadow.

gx1-lake-morning.name: Lake Morning
gx1-lake-morning.parentQuestion: What do you see across the water?
gx1-lake-morning.galLine: Tranquil open nature landscape provides deep bedtime relaxation and visual space.
gx1-lake-morning.parentNote:
A glassy blue lake reflects the pink clouds of sunrise.
Soft silver mist floats gently over the quiet water.
Along the pebbly shoreline, gentle ripples lap against smooth round stones.
Take a deep breath and listen to the sleepy morning air.

gx1-peach-tree.name: Peach Tree
gx1-peach-tree.parentQuestion: How many peaches can you count?
gx1-peach-tree.galLine: Celebrates natural harvest and orchard growth with warm, comforting colors.
gx1-peach-tree.parentNote:
In the warm sunshine stands a beautiful, leafy peach tree!
Heavy branches are dotted with round, fuzzy peaches glowing pink and gold.
A sweet, warm fruity scent fills the air as a little bumblebee buzzes by.
Nature grows delicious, sweet fruit for everyone to enjoy!

gx1-quail-family.name: Quail Family
gx1-quail-family.galLine: Nurturing animal family theme gives toddlers joy and security through miniature animal spotting.
gx1-quail-family.parentNote:
Tip-tap, tip-tap! Look at the cheerful little quail family scurrying through the grass.
Mother and Father quail have funny little feather topknots that bob with every step.
Behind them, a line of tiny fuzzy chicks scampers along like fluffy cotton balls.
They peck happily at seeds in the dirt together!

n-ambulance.name: Ambulance
n-ambulance.parentQuestion: How does the white van help people?
n-ambulance.galLine: Framed as a friendly community helper van on a calm country road, with zero screeching sirens or scary emergencies, supporting comforting medical care.
n-ambulance.parentNote:
Roll, roll! Here comes the friendly white helper van driving along the country lane.
It has a bright red cross painted on its side so everyone knows help is on the way.
Inside rests a cozy bed with warm blankets and gentle medicine for anyone feeling sick.
The friendly driver waves hello as the van rolls smoothly over the green hills.

n-boat.name: Boat
n-boat.galLine: Hub for watercraft exploration; safe harbor setting reassures toddlers with friendly, calm waters.
n-boat.parentNote:
Ahoy! The sunny harbor is full of boats floating gently on the blue water.
Sturdy docks and wooden piers keep the colorful boats safe and steady.
Seagulls glide overhead in the salty breeze while water laps against the hulls.
Boats can carry us across lakes, rivers, and all the way to faraway shores!

n-canoe.name: Canoe
n-canoe.parentQuestion: How is a canoe different from the sailboat?
n-canoe.galLine: Rhythmic paddling and quiet river travel offer soothing, peaceful bedtime vibes.
n-canoe.parentNote:
Dip, glide, dip, glide. A sleek wooden canoe glides silently across the still river.
A wooden paddle dips into the water with a quiet splash, leaving ripples behind.
Lush green reeds and water lilies line the bank where dragonflies dart.
It is so quiet and peaceful traveling in a gentle canoe!

n-digger-train.name: Freight Train
n-digger-train.parentQuestion: What do you think is inside the colorful cars?
n-digger-train.galLine: Preschool train obsession satisfied with cheerful, bright freight cars and gentle rolling sounds.
n-digger-train.parentNote:
Chugga-chugga, chugga-chugga! A powerful freight train rumbles down the heavy steel tracks.
Look at all the long, colorful railcars carrying giant logs, gravel, and cargo!
A bright engine up front pulls the whole long line around the bend.
Clickity-clack, clickity-clack, working hard all through the countryside!

n-ferry.name: Ferry
n-ferry.parentQuestion: Who could sit on the wooden benches?
n-ferry.galLine: Everyday public transit on water; large stable ferry vessel conveys safety and excitement.
n-ferry.parentNote:
Toot-toot! The big, wide ferry boat is carrying passengers and cars across the bay.
Families sit on sunny wooden benches on the open deck, looking at the water.
White foam churns softly behind the big stern as the ferry glides along.
Soon it will bump gently against the wooden pilings of the island dock!

n-fire-truck.name: Fire Truck
n-fire-truck.galLine: Community helper vehicle framed as friendly, caring rescue without sirens, fire, or danger.
n-fire-truck.parentNote:
Here comes the big, shiny red fire truck ready to help our town!
It carries a giant silver ladder that can reach all the way up to the treetops.
Long coiled hoses and brass nozzles are neatly packed in side compartments.
Friendly firefighters wave with big smiles as they keep our neighborhood safe!

n-garbage-truck.name: Garbage Truck
n-garbage-truck.parentQuestion: Which bin do you think gets picked up first?
n-garbage-truck.galLine: Beloved preschool utility vehicle celebrating routine neighborhood cleanliness and teamwork.
n-garbage-truck.parentNote:
Whir-crunch! The big green recycling and garbage truck rolls down our street.
Strong mechanical arms lift the wheeled bins high into the air and tip them in!
The driver waves a friendly hello from the high cab window.
Thank you, hardworking truck, for keeping our streets sparkling clean!

n-glider.name: Glider
n-glider.parentQuestion: How can it fly without a noisy engine?
n-glider.galLine: Silent, serene sky flight prevents sensory overload while celebrating the wonder of soaring.
n-glider.parentNote:
Whoosh... High up in the blue sky, a graceful white glider soars like a bird.
It has long, slender wings that catch the warm rising air currents.
With no engine at all, it flies in total, whisper-quiet peace!
Look down below at the tiny green patchwork fields and curving blue rivers.

n-mail-truck.name: Mail Truck
n-mail-truck.parentQuestion: Who might get one of those colorful letters?
n-mail-truck.galLine: Friendly connection with loved ones through letters; comforting neighborhood helper.
n-mail-truck.parentNote:
Beep-beep! The friendly little white mail truck stops beside each mailbox.
Inside are postcards from grandparents, colorful birthday cards, and fun packages!
The letter carrier knows everyone in town and always wears a cheerful smile.
Special messages delivered right to your front door!

n-motorcycle.name: Motorcycle
n-motorcycle.parentQuestion: Where could this red motorcycle go?
n-motorcycle.galLine: Fun two-wheeler exploring personal mobility with cheerful styling and safe parked stance.
n-motorcycle.parentNote:
Vroom-vroom! A shiny red touring motorcycle rests on its sturdy kickstand.
It has two big wheels with shiny silver spokes and comfortable cushioned seats.
A shiny round helmet with a clear visor sits ready on the handlebars.
Ready for a breezy ride down winding country lanes!

n-pickup-truck.name: Pickup Truck
n-pickup-truck.parentQuestion: What is riding in the back?
n-pickup-truck.galLine: Friendly country utility vehicle connecting farm produce with town life.
n-pickup-truck.parentNote:
Rumble-rumble! A cheerful blue pickup truck is parked beside the barn.
Its big open truck bed is filled with sweet-smelling pumpkins and garden flowers!
Sturdy tires can roll over bumpy dirt roads and grassy meadows with ease.
Ready to haul good things home from the harvest!

n-police-car.name: Police Car
n-police-car.parentQuestion: Who might ride in this little blue car?
n-police-car.galLine: Community safety helper framed warmly as a friendly guide who helps lost kids and assists neighbors.
n-police-car.parentNote:
A neat blue-and-white cruiser car patrols the quiet town square.
A friendly officer smiles and waves through the open window to children playing.
Bright yellow safety vests and a little notebook sit on the passenger seat.
Always here to help friends cross the street safely and find their way home!

n-rowboat.name: Rowboat
n-rowboat.parentQuestion: How do the oars move the boat?
n-rowboat.galLine: Classic nursery rhyme connection with soothing, slow rhythmic oar motion.
n-rowboat.parentNote:
Creak, splash... A cozy wooden rowboat floats near the sandy shore.
Two wooden oars rest in brass oarlocks, ready for a calm morning row.
Beneath the boat, clear water lets you see green pebbles and tiny minnows.
Row, row, row your boat, gently down the stream!

n-sailboat.name: Sailboat
n-sailboat.parentQuestion: Why is this boat tied to the dock?
n-sailboat.galLine: Gentle wind-powered voyage with bright open-water palette and cheerful flags.
n-sailboat.parentNote:
Look at the tall white triangle sail catching the summer breeze!
The wooden hull leans gently as it cuts through the sparkling blue waves.
A colorful pennant flutters merrily from the top of the tall wooden mast.
The wind pushes the sails, carrying the boat across the bay!

n-school-bus.name: School Bus
n-school-bus.parentQuestion: Where do you think the yellow bus is going?
n-school-bus.galLine: Universal childhood milestone vehicle reinforced with familiar nursery rhyme imagery.
n-school-bus.parentNote:
Honk-honk! The big yellow school bus brings friends together every morning.
Rows of big glass windows show smiling children waving to their families.
The big stop sign folds out safely as the folding doors open wide.
The wheels on the bus go round and round, all through the town!

n-scooter.name: Scooter
n-scooter.parentQuestion: Where would you scoot along this path?
n-scooter.galLine: Active toddler gross-motor vehicle that Daniel and Gal directly relate to from park play.
n-scooter.parentNote:
Kick, push, and glide! A bright turquoise kick-scooter stands on the park path.
It has soft rubber handlebars, a grippy deck, and three smooth-rolling wheels.
A little chrome bell on the handlebar gives a friendly ring-ring!
Zip along the sidewalk with the wind in your hair!

n-submarine.name: Submarine
n-submarine.parentQuestion: What can you see through the round window?
n-submarine.galLine: Whimsical yellow submarine adventure framed as gentle exploration of colorful sea life.
n-submarine.parentNote:
Glub-glub! A friendly yellow exploration submarine dives under the ocean waves.
Through thick round portholes, we can see bright tropical fish swimming right up to say hello!
A soft bubble trail drifts upward toward the sunny surface above.
What secret undersea treasures will we discover today?

n-taxi.name: Taxi
n-taxi.parentQuestion: Where do you think the yellow car is going?
n-taxi.galLine: Classic city vehicle providing friendly point-to-point transportation.
n-taxi.parentNote:
Beep-beep! A bright yellow taxi cab cruises past the park fountain.
A little taxi sign on the roof lights up warmly to show it is ready for passengers.
Inside are comfy checkered seats and a big street map on the dashboard.
Where would you like to go today? Hop in!

n-tractor.name: Tractor
n-tractor.parentQuestion: What do the big back wheels help it do?
n-tractor.galLine: Top-tier toddler favorite celebrating farming power and agricultural machinery safely.
n-tractor.parentNote:
Chug-chug-chug! The big green farm tractor works out in the sunny fields.
Look at its enormous knobby back tires that can climb over dirt and mud!
Behind it, a metal plow turns over rich brown soil ready for new seeds.
A friendly farmer waves from the high open seat!

n-tugboat.name: Tugboat
n-tugboat.parentQuestion: What could this little boat push?
n-tugboat.galLine: Beloved little-engine-that-could archetype showing that small helpers can do huge jobs.
n-tugboat.parentNote:
Toot! A little red tugboat might look small, but it is super strong!
Thick rope bumpers protect its round nose as it gently nudges giant ships into dock.
Its powerful propeller churns up white bubbly foam in the deep blue water.
A true little helper of the harbor!

n-wagon.name: Wagon
n-wagon.parentQuestion: What is filling the red wagon?
n-wagon.galLine: Quintessential toddler play vehicle anchoring hands-on play and familiar bedroom/yard routines.
n-wagon.parentNote:
Squeak-roll, squeak-roll! A classic little red wooden wagon rests on the lawn.
It has a long pull handle with a comfortable grip, ready for little hands.
Inside the deep red box, a favorite teddy bear and wooden blocks ride along.
Pull your treasures everywhere you go!

q-farm.name: Farm
q-farm.galLine: A rich, quintessential storybook farm hub that invites toddlers and preschoolers to explore classic animal sounds, vehicles, and fresh harvest foods in an entirely sunny and secure setting.
q-farm.parentNote:
Welcome to the sunny farm! The rooster crows as morning breaks over the green hills.
A friendly spotted cow and a smiling pink pig say hello near the dirt path.
Look at the red tractor parked by the barn, ready for a busy day in the fields.
Everywhere you look, animals are grazing and yummy vegetables are growing!

q-barn.name: Barn
q-barn.parentQuestion: What do you think is stored in the hay?
q-barn.galLine: A welcoming, sunny depiction of a farm barn; open doors and glowing golden hay emphasize shelter, warmth, and agricultural abundance with zero dark or scary corners.
q-barn.parentNote:
Step through the open wooden doors into the cozy red barn!
Inside, tall stacks of sweet golden hay reach all the way up to the rafters.
The barn keeps the farm animals warm and dry when the rain falls outside.
All around the barnyard, leafy apple trees are filled with bright red apples.

q-beehive.name: Beehive
q-beehive.parentQuestion: Where do the bees take the flower nectar?
q-beehive.galLine: Bees are presented as cheerful, fuzzy pollinator helpers in an idyllic flower garden, completely removing preschool fears of bee stings while introducing how honey is made.
q-beehive.parentNote:
Buzz, buzz! Out in the sunny meadow stands a cozy wooden beehive.
Friendly little honeybees fly from flower to flower, sipping sweet nectar.
They carry the golden nectar home through the hive's front door.
Inside, the bees work together to make sweet, delicious honey for everyone to enjoy!

q-chickens.name: Hen and Chicks
q-chickens.parentQuestion: How many chicks can you count?
q-chickens.galLine: Counting five baby chicks alongside their affectionate mother hen provides a rich numeracy moment wrapped in gentle, classic nursery-rhyme warmth.
q-chickens.parentNote:
Cluck, cluck! Mother hen stands proudly in the warm green grass.
All around her gather five fuzzy yellow chicks!
Can you count them? One, two, three, four, five little balls of fluff!
"Peep, peep, peep!" they chirp, pecking happily at tiny golden grain seeds.

q-cow.name: Cow
q-cow.parentQuestion: What do we get from a cow?
q-cow.galLine: A cheerful, quintessential farm animal encounter; chewing grass with a happy smile connects cows directly to milk and nature in a fun, peaceful way.
q-cow.parentNote:
"Moo-oo!" Here is our friendly dairy cow standing in the sunny green pasture.
She is happily munching a mouthful of sweet, crunchy green grass!
Her coat has big, bold spots of black and white, and her pink nose is soft and cool.
Every day she gives fresh, healthy milk to make butter and cheese.

q-donkey.name: Donkey
q-donkey.parentQuestion: How are a donkey's ears different from a horse's?
q-donkey.galLine: The donkey's expressive oversized ears and kind eyes make it instantly approachable and endearing, prompting fun preschool ear-wiggling and "hee-haw" vocal play.
q-donkey.parentNote:
Look at this gentle grey donkey standing by the pasture fence!
He has two tall, furry ears that can twist all around to listen to every sound.
"Hee-haw, hee-haw!" he calls out with a cheerful farm greeting.
His soft white muzzle loves gentle nose pats, and his fluffy tail swishes happily.

q-duck-pond.name: Duck Pond
q-duck-pond.parentQuestion: Why do ducks have webbed feet?
q-duck-pond.galLine: A calm water haven featuring familiar ducks, ducklings, and water lilies; paddling webbed feet and gentle water sounds offer serene, comforting exploration.
q-duck-pond.parentNote:
Paddle, paddle, splash! The farm pond is alive with gentle rippling water.
Green-headed mallard ducks glide smoothly between the wide green lily pads.
Two tiny, fuzzy yellow ducklings paddle right behind, kicking their little orange feet!
All around the pond, blooming white water lilies open their petals in the warm morning sun.

q-goat.name: Goat
q-goat.galLine: Goats are beloved by young children for their playful curiosity and funny chewing; a smiling face, little beard, and gentle munching make this encounter delightfully comical and completely friendly.
q-goat.parentNote:
"Maa-aa!" Here comes a cheerful little goat with curved brown horns.
He has a fuzzy little white beard on his chin that wiggles whenever he chews.
Munch, munch, crunch! He is nibbling on a juicy green garden leaf.
This little goat loves to hop, skip, and explore all around the farmyard fence.

q-hay.name: Hay
q-hay.parentQuestion: How many hay bales can you count?
q-hay.galLine: Giant round hay bales are an iconic roadside sight that children love spotting; counting the stacked bales provides tangible numeracy and celebrates harvest teamwork.
q-hay.parentNote:
Look at all the big, round bales of golden hay resting in the sunlit field!
The tractor rolled the sweet summer grass into giant round bundles.
Can you count the bales in the big stack? One, two, three, four, five, six—and one more rolling nearby!
In winter, the cows, horses, and sheep will eat this delicious, sweet-smelling hay.

q-orchard.name: Orchard
q-orchard.parentQuestion: How many apples can you count?
q-orchard.galLine: Apple picking is an accessible, sensory-rich autumn experience; recognizing that apples grow on trees and are gathered into baskets fosters food awareness and harvest appreciation.
q-orchard.parentNote:
Welcome to the sunny apple orchard! The air smells sweet and crisp.
Look at the big apple tree on the hill—its green branches are filled with bright red apples!
A wooden ladder leans against the tree, ready for reaching the highest fruit.
Underneath, a woven basket is piled high with juicy, crunchy apples to eat.

q-pig.name: Pig
q-pig.parentQuestion: Why does a pig like mud?
q-pig.galLine: Pigs are an instant favorite for preschool vocalizations; presenting a clean, happy pig enjoying garden vegetables keeps the tone cheerful, wholesome, and delightfully funny.
q-pig.parentNote:
"Oink, oink!" A cheerful pink pig smiles as he trots through the clean golden straw.
Look what is growing in his garden trough: crunchy orange carrots, leafy greens, and a purple beet!
Tall, sunny sunflowers smile behind the wooden planter box.
After his garden snack, this happy pig loves to roll in soft, cool mud to stay cool on warm days!

q-rabbit.name: Rabbit
q-rabbit.parentQuestion: Why are a rabbit's ears so long?
q-rabbit.galLine: A deeply endearing, gentle bunny portrait designed to melt toddlers' hearts; floppy ears, quiet observation, and soft daisies provide tactile comfort and emotional warmth.
q-rabbit.parentNote:
Shh... look who is sitting quietly in the warm morning meadow!
It is a sweet little bunny rabbit with long, velvety lop ears that hang down past its cheeks.
Its soft golden-brown fur is as fluffy as a downy cloud.
Sniff, sniff! Its tiny pink nose twitches as it sniffs the fresh white daisies all around.

q-rooster.name: Rooster
q-rooster.galLine: The morning rooster crow is one of the most recognizable animal routines in preschool lore; perched proudly on the fence, he welcomes the day with pure enthusiasm and bright farm colors.
q-rooster.parentNote:
"Cock-a-doodle-doo!" The proud farm rooster stands tall atop the wooden fence.
He greets the brand-new morning with a joyful song to wake the sleeping farm!
Look at his bright red comb on his head and his shiny golden-orange feathers.
His long green tail feathers curve gracefully in the fresh morning breeze.

q-scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
q-scarecrow.parentQuestion: What job does a scarecrow do?
q-scarecrow.galLine: Scarecrows can sometimes seem spooky in halloween contexts, but here he is completely warm, smiling, and friendly like a gentle farm companion protecting the garden vegetables.
q-scarecrow.parentNote:
Out in the vegetable garden stands a friendly scarecrow with a big, happy smile!
He wears a floppy straw hat and a cozy jacket covered in colorful patches.
His straw hands wave gently in the morning breeze to say hello to the flying birds.
All around his wooden post, giant leafy cabbages grow big and round in the soil.

q-sheep.name: Sheep
q-sheep.parentQuestion: What do we make from a sheep's wool?
q-sheep.galLine: A gentle nursery staple celebrating wool, warmth, and maternal affection; peaceful sleeping/smiling eyes on both sheep ensure a deeply soothing bedtime tone.
q-sheep.parentNote:
"Baa, baa!" A fluffy mother sheep smiles gently in the green meadow.
Her thick, woolly fleece is as soft and white as a puffy cloud.
Beside her stands her sweet little lamb, snuggling close by the wooden fence.
Their warm wool keeps them cozy, and in the springtime it is sheared to make warm mittens and blankets!

q-tractor.name: Tractor
q-tractor.parentQuestion: What job does a tractor do?
q-tractor.galLine: Big tractors are an elemental preschool vehicle passion; clear mechanical shapes, bold red paint, and tactile tire treads provide immense mechanical satisfaction with zero danger.
q-tractor.parentNote:
Chug, chug, chug! Here is the big, strong red tractor hard at work on the farm.
Look at those giant black wheels with deep, bumpy treads for driving through the dirt!
The tractor pulls heavy plows to turn the soil into neat, soft rows.
Now the dark, rich earth is ready for planting seeds that will grow into healthy food.

q-windmill.name: Windmill
q-windmill.parentQuestion: What makes a windmill's sails turn?
q-windmill.galLine: The iconic rotating windmill brings together wind, kinetic motion, and the story of how grain becomes flour, framed in a peaceful, sun-warmed countryside landscape.
q-windmill.parentNote:
High up on the breezy green hill stands a tall wooden windmill!
Look at its four giant criss-cross sails catching the fresh morning wind.
Round and round they turn: whoosh, turn, whoosh, turn!
Inside, heavy round stones spin around to grind golden wheat into soft white flour for baking bread.

r-jungle.name: Jungle
r-jungle.galLine: A magical, peaceful rainforest hub where wild animals coexist in gentle harmony; the calm, friendly expressions of the lion and elephant remove all predatory scare, inspiring pure preschool wonder.
r-jungle.parentNote:
Step quietly into the warm, green jungle! Golden sunlight filters through the tall canopy trees.
A gentle elephant flaps his big ears, and a calm lion rests peacefully in the cool moss.
High up on a vine-covered branch, a playful little monkey waves hello!
And look—a tall spotted giraffe and a striped zebra are grazing together among the flowers.

r-elephant.name: Elephant
r-elephant.parentQuestion: What is that long nose for?
