r-elephant.galLine: A gentle, smiling elephant calf with rounded shapes and friendly eyes turns the largest land mammal into a cuddly, gentle giant that inspires affection and trunk-mimicking gestures.
r-elephant.parentNote:
Stomp, stomp, swish! A sweet young elephant smiles in the sunlit jungle path.
His big, floppy ears flap gently like giant fans to keep him cool.
Look at his long, curvy trunk—it can pick up a tiny twig of tender green leaves!
He lifts his leafy snack to his mouth with a happy, friendly rumble.

r-lion.name: Lion
r-lion.parentQuestion: Why do you think a lion has a mane?
r-lion.galLine: Lions can sometimes be portrayed aggressively in wildlife shows, but here father and cub embody loving parental security, gentle affection, and cozy storybook warmth with zero predatory menace.
r-lion.parentNote:
In a peaceful sunlit clearing, a noble father lion rests in the soft golden grass.
Around his head flows a magnificent, fluffy golden mane like a crown of warm sunshine.
Snuggled safely against his paws is his sweet little lion cub!
"Purr, purr," rumbles the big lion softly, watching his baby with loving, gentle eyes.

r-monkey.name: Monkey
r-monkey.parentQuestion: How does a monkey hold on with its tail?
r-monkey.galLine: The monkey holding a banana is a quintessential storybook joy; round friendly features, a bright smile, and familiar vocal play provide delightful, giggly preschool engagement.
r-monkey.parentNote:
Ooh, ooh, aah, aah! Look at this cheerful little monkey perched on the mossy branch.
He is holding a delicious, sweet yellow banana with both of his hands!
Look at his long, curly tail: it can wrap around branches like an extra hand to hold on tight.
He loves to swing through the sunny green treetops and play with his jungle friends!

r-zebra.name: Zebra
r-zebra.parentQuestion: Are a zebra's stripes black or white?
r-zebra.galLine: Classic high-contrast animal patterns offer strong visual recognition and joyful counting of stripes.
r-zebra.parentNote:
Clip-clop! A gentle zebra trots happily across the sunlit clearing.
Look at its crisp black-and-white stripes that paint pretty patterns along its side.
Its fluffy black mane stands straight up along its neck like a tidy brush.
It swishes its tail to chase away flies and nibbles sweet jungle grasses with friends.

r-giraffe.name: Giraffe
r-giraffe.parentQuestion: Why is a giraffe's neck so long?
r-giraffe.galLine: Giraffes are a beloved preschool favorite for their extraordinary height; showing the giraffe calmly munching leaves connects anatomy to diet in an uplifting, wonder-filled way.
r-giraffe.parentNote:
Reach way, way up high! A tall, gentle giraffe stands among the sunny trees.
Her long, spotted neck reaches right into the treetop canopy.
Munch, munch! She gently nibbles the tender green leaves that only she can reach.
Her golden coat has warm brown spots, and her kind eyes smile down at the forest below.

r-waterfall.name: Waterfall
r-waterfall.parentQuestion: Where do you think the water goes?
r-waterfall.galLine: Soothing natural water sounds and soft mist rainbow provide deep sensory grounding and calm.
r-waterfall.parentNote:
A sparkling crystal waterfall cascades down smooth mossy river rocks.
Soft white mist rises like gentle steam, creating a magical little rainbow in the sun.
Down in the turquoise river pool below, smooth pebbles glow in the clear shallows.
The sound of falling water is so gentle, like a soothing bedtime lullaby.

r-parrot.name: Parrot
r-parrot.parentQuestion: What colors can you find on this parrot?
r-parrot.galLine: Parrots are a favorite vehicle for color identification (red, yellow, green, blue); the friendly open eye, open beak, and rainbow plumage offer rich visual delight and fun vocal mimicry.
r-parrot.parentNote:
Squawk, chirp! Perched on a mossy jungle branch sits a dazzling scarlet parrot!
His feathers shine in brilliant colors: bright red, sunny yellow, grass green, and ocean blue!
Look at his strong, curved grey beak—it can crack open tasty nuts and seeds.
When he spreads his colorful wings, he looks like a flying rainbow sailing through the trees!

r-toucan.name: Toucan
r-toucan.parentQuestion: Why do you think its beak is so big?
r-toucan.galLine: Playful, colorful tropical bird delights preschoolers with bright shapes and friendly berry snacking.
r-toucan.parentNote:
Hop, hop! A bright, cheerful toucan perches proudly on a tropical blossom branch.
Look at its enormous rainbow beak glowing with orange, yellow, and turquoise stripes!
Even though its bill looks huge, it is super light like honeycombed paper.
The toucan tosses a ripe purple berry into the air and catches it with a happy snap!

r-chameleon.name: Chameleon
r-chameleon.parentQuestion: What color is the chameleon today?
r-chameleon.galLine: Chameleons fascinate young children through color changes and curly tails; the oversized smiling face and friendly eyes turn a curious reptile into an endearing, gentle friend.
r-chameleon.parentNote:
Look closely at the mossy tree branch: can you spot the friendly chameleon?
His bumpy skin is colored bright green and sunny yellow to match the rainforest leaves!
He holds on tight with his special mitten-like feet, and his tail curls into a tidy spiral.
His big, round eyes can look in two different directions at the very same time!

r-hippo.name: Hippo
r-hippo.parentQuestion: Why does a hippo like the water?
r-hippo.galLine: Hippos in nature can be formidable, but here the round, smiling character and peaceful wading pool present a gentle, comforting bath-time friend that preschoolers adore.
r-hippo.parentNote:
Splish, splash! A round, friendly hippopotamus wades into the cool jungle river.
The cool water feels wonderful on his smooth, grey skin in the warm tropical heat.
Look at his tiny, perky ears—they wiggle whenever water splashes on them!
He loves to float like a big friendly boat between the round green lily pads.

r-lemur.name: Lemur
r-lemur.parentQuestion: What is that striped tail for?
r-lemur.galLine: Big luminous eyes and a high-contrast striped tail make the lemur instantly captivating for toddlers; gentle expressions and soft fur create an irresistible storybook friend.
r-lemur.parentNote:
Peek-a-boo! A fuzzy little ring-tailed lemur sits high up on a mossy jungle branch.
His big, golden eyes are wide and bright, watching everything in the forest!
Look at his extraordinary tail: it has bold black and white stripes all the way to the tip!
When he hops from tree to tree, his long striped tail helps him balance high in the air.

r-orangutan.name: Orangutan
r-orangutan.parentQuestion: How does an orangutan hold on in the trees?
r-orangutan.galLine: Orangutans' slow, gentle tree-dwelling habits and expressive, compassionate eyes provide a tranquil, comforting encounter that highlights forest stewardship and quiet observation.
r-orangutan.parentNote:
High up in the leafy green treetops sits a gentle, shaggy orangutan.
His soft, long reddish-orange fur glows brightly in the warm morning sunshine.
He holds on safely to the thick branch with his strong, gentle feet and hands.
In one hand, he holds a little sprig of green leaves, smiling kindly at the peaceful forest.

r-peacock.name: Peacock
r-peacock.parentQuestion: What are those spots on the tail?
r-peacock.galLine: Peacocks dazzle young children with their iridescent colors and "eye" patterns; the calm standing posture and gentle woodland lighting make this regal bird feel friendly and approachable.
r-peacock.parentNote:
Step into the sunny forest clearing and look at the magnificent peacock!
His slender neck shines like royal blue velvet, and a tiny crown of feathers sits atop his head.
Trailing behind him is a long, shimmering train of emerald green and gold feathers.
Each feather has a special round "eye" spot of bright turquoise and deep blue!

r-sloth.name: Sloth
r-sloth.parentQuestion: Why do you think a sloth moves so slowly?
r-sloth.galLine: Slow, peaceful sloth movements naturally encourage calm breathing and unhurried bedtime relaxation.
r-sloth.parentNote:
Way up in the green jungle canopy, a sweet little brown sloth hangs upside-down.
With long, curved claws, it holds tight to the smooth branch and smiles sleepily.
It moves so, so slowly—one little reach at a time, without any hurry at all.
Take your time, sleepy friend; the sunny day is yours to enjoy!

r-tree-frog.name: Tree Frog
r-tree-frog.parentQuestion: How does a frog hold on to a leaf?
r-tree-frog.galLine: Friendly miniature tree frog connects back to the bedroom terrarium frog with gentle, waxy tropical textures.
r-tree-frog.parentNote:
Look closely at the big waxy green leaf! A tiny bright green tree frog is resting there.
It has round orange suction cups on the tips of its toes that stick like magic suction cups.
Its big, shiny red eyes blink softly at the sparkling jungle dewdrops.
Ribbit! It makes a tiny, friendly chirp and stays safe on its leafy green home.

s-space.name: Outer Space
s-space.parentQuestion: What is out past the stars?
s-space.galLine: A breathtaking, welcoming space hub that frames outer space as a peaceful, glowing storybook wonderland full of safe discoveries.
s-space.parentNote:
Step through the window and fly out into magical outer space!
Far beyond the quiet town, rivers of purple stardust and glowing stars stretch out forever.
Look at the golden crescent moon, the ringed planet Saturn, and our curved blue Earth below!
There are so many wonderful worlds, astronauts, and flying comets waiting to be explored!

s-sun.name: The Sun
s-sun.parentQuestion: Why does the Sun feel warm?
s-sun.galLine: Depicting the Sun as a gentle, warm companion star bringing cozy light to our Earth provides a clear, comforting foundation for early astronomy.
s-sun.parentNote:
Good morning, golden Sun! The Sun is the biggest, warmest star in our sky!
Its gentle golden rays warm our grass, help flowers grow, and wake the birds.
Look at our blue Earth floating nearby, basking happily in the cozy sunlight.
Every morning the Sun rises to bring light, warmth, and joy to the whole world!

s-moon.name: The Moon
s-moon.parentQuestion: What do you see on the Moon?
s-moon.galLine: A huge, buttery-yellow full Moon acting as a comforting celestial nightlight makes space feel safe, warm, and deeply reassuring.
s-moon.parentNote:
Look at the giant, friendly Moon glowing like a big warm nightlight!
Its surface is covered in gentle round craters and soft golden hills.
Way off in the distance, tiny planet Earth shines like a blue marble.
Let's zoom in close to see what it feels like to stand right on the Moon!

s-moon-surface.name: On the Moon
s-moon-surface.parentQuestion: What would it feel like to stand there?
s-moon-surface.galLine: Portraying the lunar landscape in warm buttery-cream sand with gentle rolling craters invites fun, imaginative bouncy footsteps for preschoolers.
s-moon-surface.parentNote:
We have landed right on the surface of the Moon!
The ground is soft and sandy, with smooth round craters everywhere.
Look way up into the dark sky—there is our home, Earth, shining blue and bright!
If you took a little step here, you could jump high, high, high into the air!

s-earth-from-space.name: Earth from Space
s-earth-from-space.parentQuestion: Can you find where we live?
s-earth-from-space.galLine: Seeing Earth as a friendly, glowing round home nestled safely among soft clouds gives young children an intuitive sense of our planet.
s-earth-from-space.parentNote:
Here is our beautiful home, planet Earth, floating like a blue jewel in space!
Look at the deep blue oceans and the lovely green and golden lands where we live.
Fluffy white clouds drift gently over the continents like soft blankets.
All around our world, tiny stars twinkle in the peaceful purple sky.

s-planets.name: Planets
s-planets.galLine: Gathering colorful, recognizable planets into a friendly space neighborhood gives preschoolers a joyful first overview of the solar system.
s-planets.parentNote:
Welcome to our wonderful cosmic neighborhood filled with floating planet friends!
Look at big golden Saturn wearing its giant glowing hula-hoop rings.
Right down in the middle is our cozy blue-and-green Earth, and there is red Mars nearby!
Every planet is a special, colorful world dancing peacefully together in space.

s-mars.name: Mars
s-mars.galLine: Portraying the red planet with soft warm gouache tones and an inviting snowy cap makes planetary science cozy and approachable for little learners.
s-mars.parentNote:
Here is Mars, the friendly red planet glowing brightly in space!
It has warm rusty-orange rocks and tall sleeping mountains.
Look right at the very top—there is a white snowy cap of ice!
Mars floats peacefully like a big warm marble in the starry night.

s-astronaut.name: Astronaut
s-astronaut.parentQuestion: What would you wear in space?
s-astronaut.galLine: A cheerful, waving astronaut floating safely in a warm puffy suit turns human space exploration into an accessible, friendly bedtime adventure.
s-astronaut.parentNote:
A friendly astronaut floats gently among the glowing stars!
Their big round gold helmet shines warmly in the cosmic light.
Look at them waving a happy hello with their soft white glove!
Out here in space, you can float and drift as light as a feather.

s-space-station.name: Space Station
s-space-station.parentQuestion: Who might live in those glowing windows?
s-space-station.galLine: Designing the space station as a cozy floating pod with warm glowing round windows makes astronaut life feel safe, familiar, and comforting for young kids.
s-space-station.parentNote:
High above planet Earth floats a cozy home among the stars: the space station!
Look at those round porthole windows glowing with warm, welcoming yellow light.
Inside, astronauts can sleep in floating beds, eat yummy snacks, and look out at the world.
Its blue solar wings gather sunny power as it glides softly through the night sky.

s-satellite.name: Satellite
s-satellite.parentQuestion: What is that little ship doing up there?
s-satellite.galLine: Giving the satellite a smiling face and cozy outstretched solar wings transforms a high-tech orbital machine into a friendly space helper for toddlers.
s-satellite.parentNote:
Beep, beep, beep! Here is a cheerful little satellite gliding high above our world!
It has two blue solar panel wings that catch warm sunlight like friendly hands.
Look at its sweet smiling face and rosy cheeks as it peeks down at Earth.
Its gentle golden lamp shines bright, sending messages and pictures back down to us!

s-telescope.name: Telescope
s-telescope.parentQuestion: What could you look at through that?
s-telescope.galLine: A gleaming brass telescope standing invitingly on a flowery hill encourages toddlers to look up, wonder, and explore the night sky.
s-telescope.parentNote:
Peep through the little eyepiece of the golden telescope!
It stands sturdy on its wooden tripod in the soft green meadow grass.
Its polished brass barrel points right up into the twinkling night sky.
With a telescope, far-away moons, rings, and stars look close enough to touch!

s-galaxy.name: A Galaxy
s-galaxy.parentQuestion: How many stars are in a swirl?
s-galaxy.galLine: A galaxy framed as a friendly, glowing celestial pinwheel over a sleepy meadow inspires awe and bedtime calm without abstract or dizzying scale.
s-galaxy.parentNote:
Look at that giant swirl of light spinning gently in the night sky!
It is a whole galaxy made of millions and millions of cozy glowing stars.
The arms of the galaxy curl around like a warm pinwheel made of stardust.
From our quiet grassy hill, we can look up and dream of all the magical worlds inside.

s-nebula.name: Nebula
s-nebula.parentQuestion: What colors do you see in that cloud?
s-nebula.galLine: Framing a nebula as a warm, colorful nursery cloud where baby stars rest creates a whimsical and reassuring bedtime metaphor.
s-nebula.parentNote:
High up in the night sky floats a magical, glowing cloud called a nebula!
It shines with soft shades of purple, pink, and warm glowing peach.
Inside this cozy cosmic cloud, brand new baby stars are slowly being born!
Down below, the purple flowers in the grass look up in quiet wonder.

s-star-cluster.name: Star Cluster
s-star-cluster.galLine: Clustering five-pointed stars into a warm, cheerful celestial gathering feels like a classic bedtime nursery rhyme brought to life.
s-star-cluster.parentNote:
Twinkle, twinkle! Look at all the happy star friends gathered together in the sky!
It is a big, glittering star cluster, glowing like a family of cozy golden lights.
Some stars are big and bright, and some are tiny baby sparkles snuggled close.
They shine down on our sleepy green meadow, wishing everyone a sweet, restful night.

s-comet.name: Comet
s-comet.parentQuestion: Where is that bright tail going?
s-comet.galLine: A comet depicted as a friendly streak of warm golden starlight over a quiet meadow evokes peaceful bedtime wonder rather than any scary impact.
s-comet.parentNote:
Zoom! A bright, friendly comet swoops across the deep purple night sky!
Its long glowing tail shines like a river of golden glitter.
Down below, the sleepy green hills and tiny purple flowers watch it fly.
Where is the happy comet traveling on its journey past the stars?

s-asteroids.name: Asteroids
s-asteroids.galLine: Depicting asteroids as smooth, rounded floating stones in a soft glowing nebula keeps space rocks approachable and calming rather than rocky or dangerous for preschoolers.
s-asteroids.parentNote:
Look at all the gentle space rocks tumbling softly through the stars!
They float along like giant smooth pebbles drifting down a quiet river.
Each asteroid is round and friendly, glowing in the soft starlight.
Way up above, a golden crescent moon watches them drift peacefully by.

s-meteor-shower.name: Meteor Shower
s-meteor-shower.galLine: Shooting stars presented as friendly, wish-granting streaks of golden light over a peaceful glowing Earth create an enchanting, comforting bedtime experience.
s-meteor-shower.parentNote:
Look! Bright shooting stars are dancing across the velvet purple sky!
Each little meteor leaves a sparkling golden trail as it zips along.
High above our curved blue Earth, the sky is full of wonder and light.
Make a sweet bedtime wish as they glide softly through the night!

s-orbit.name: Moon Going Around
s-orbit.parentQuestion: Which one is going around the other?
s-orbit.galLine: Showing an orbit as a sparkling golden train track makes planetary motion concrete, delightful, and easy for young minds to grasp.
s-orbit.parentNote:
Round and round goes the gentle Moon, traveling in a big loop around our Earth!
Look at that sparkling golden track showing the Moon's quiet journey through space.
The Moon never gets lost—it circles our blue home like a loyal friend.
Round and round, day and night, keeping us safe and cozy down below!

w-tall-mountains.name: Tall Mountains
w-tall-mountains.parentQuestion: How high do you think the peaks go?
w-tall-mountains.galLine: Majestic mountain scale made inviting and cozy; sheer cliffs are softened with rounded edges and playful animals, creating wonder without vertigo or danger.
w-tall-mountains.parentNote:
High up in the cool, fresh air, giant mountain peaks touch the sky.
Fluffy white clouds float past snowy summits like soft cotton puffs.
Nimble mountain goats hop easily from rock to rock on the cliffs.
Tucked into the rocky hillside is a cozy cave where little bats sleep peacefully.

w-alpine-meadow.name: Alpine Wildflower Meadow
w-alpine-meadow.galLine: A lush, colorful garden high in the sky; friendly chubby marmots and splashing streams make the high alpine feel warm, welcoming, and teeming with gentle life.
w-alpine-meadow.parentNote:
High up on the sunny mountain slope, a carpet of bright wildflowers blooms!
Yellow buttercups, blue gentians, and pink clover nod gently in the fresh breeze.
A plump, furry marmot sits up on a warm flat rock and whistles a happy tune.
A clear, cold snowmelt stream trickles over smooth colored pebbles down the hill.

w-mountain-goats.name: Mountain Goats on the Crags
w-mountain-goats.parentQuestion: How do their feet hold on to the rocks?
w-mountain-goats.galLine: Celebrates physical agility, balancing, and animal play; rock steps feel completely safe and grounded, encouraging preschool jumping mimicry.
w-mountain-goats.parentNote:
Hop, leap, balance! Mountain goats are the world's best climbers.
Their special hooves have soft rubbery pads underneath that grip tight to rocky edges.
A fluffy mother goat watches her twin kids practice jumping on low stepping stones.
The mountain wind blows their thick white coats, keeping them warm and snug.

w-playful-goat-kids.name: Playful Goat Kids
w-playful-goat-kids.parentQuestion: Can you hop like the little goats?
w-playful-goat-kids.galLine: High-energy playful movement mirrors preschool physical joy; captures active hopping and bonding with sweet, reassuring humor.
w-playful-goat-kids.parentNote:
Bounce, bounce! These two little goat kids love to play tag on the mountain rocks!
They have springy legs that make them hop like fluffy white popcorn.
One baby goat does a silly sideways twist and lands perfectly on all four hooves.
Then they gently tap their foreheads together to say, "You're my best friend!"

w-friendly-bat-cave.name: Cave with Friendly Bats
w-friendly-bat-cave.parentQuestion: How do the little bats sleep?
w-friendly-bat-cave.galLine: Frames bats as cute, gentle, furry creatures that wrap up cozy like sleepy toddlers; replaces spooky darkness with magical crystal glows and soothing water sounds.
w-friendly-bat-cave.parentNote:
Step inside the cool, peaceful mountain cave!
The air is fresh and quiet, filled with the soft clink of mineral water drops.
High up on the ceiling, little brown bats wrap their wings around themselves like cozy blankets.
Sparkling purple and gold crystals line the rocky walls, glowing like nightlights.

w-desert-dunes.name: Desert Dunes
w-desert-dunes.parentQuestion: What do you think lives in the warm sand?
w-desert-dunes.galLine: Warm and comforting desert landscape with soft sweeping shapes; presents the desert as an inviting, sun-warmed playground filled with friendly animals rather than a harsh or lonely wasteland.
w-desert-dunes.parentNote:
Golden sand stretches out beneath the warm, gentle sun.
Soft breeze blows ripples across the rolling dunes like ocean waves.
A line of friendly camels walks softly across the crest of the hill.
Down below, green palm trees wave beside a cool, sparkling blue pool.

w-baby-camel.name: Baby Camel
w-baby-camel.parentQuestion: What does a baby camel's coat feel like?
w-baby-camel.galLine: Baby animals tap directly into preschool nurturing instincts; highlights woolly textures and sweet maternal reassurance to promote calm emotional safety.
w-baby-camel.parentNote:
Look at this fuzzy baby camel learning to walk on long wobbly legs!
Its woolly coat is super soft, like a warm teddy bear blanket.
Its little hump is still soft and floppy until it grows big and strong.
When mother camel gives a low, friendly hum, the baby nuzzles her nose.

w-camel-caravan.name: Camel Caravan
w-camel-caravan.parentQuestion: Why don't the camels sink in the sand?
w-camel-caravan.galLine: Celebrates animal family warmth and camel adaptations (wide feet, humps) in an approachable, tactile way that invites physical connection.
w-camel-caravan.parentNote:
Clip-clop, soft feet pad across the warm sand dunes!
Camels have big, wide padded feet that keep them from sinking into the sand.
A mother camel wears a colorful woven blanket and walks alongside her sweet little calf.
Their humps hold energy so they can travel across the desert for many sunny days.

w-cactus-garden.name: Saguaro Cactus Garden
w-cactus-garden.parentQuestion: How does a cactus hold so much water?
w-cactus-garden.galLine: Frames desert plants as gentle homes and water holders rather than sharp dangers; giant cacti waving arms and slow tortoises offer delightful physical mimicry.
w-cactus-garden.parentNote:
Look at the giant green saguaro cactus waving its friendly green arms!
Inside its thick, ribbed skin, the cactus stores water like a big green canteen.
At the very top of each branch grow creamy white flowers filled with sweet nectar.
Down below among the pebbles, an ancient desert tortoise crawls slowly and steadily along.

w-fennec-fox-den.name: Fennec Fox Den
w-fennec-fox-den.parentQuestion: Why are the fox's ears so big?
w-fennec-fox-den.galLine: Fennec foxes are irresistible to young kids due to baby-like proportions and giant ears; highlights sensory hearing adaptations in a sweet, storybook tone.
w-fennec-fox-den.parentNote:
Shh! Deep inside a soft sandy den, the fennec foxes are waking up!
They are the smallest foxes in the whole world, with the biggest, cutest ears.
Their giant ears help them listen for beetles rustling under the sand.
Their paws have furry little slippers so the hot sand never hurts their toes.

w-meerkat-mound.name: Meerkat Mound
w-meerkat-mound.parentQuestion: Where do the meerkats go when they pop down?
w-meerkat-mound.galLine: Meerkats standing upright like children are naturally humorous and relatable; frames vigilance as caring for friends and family with zero scary predator encounters.
w-meerkat-mound.parentNote:
Pop, pop, pop! Up pop the meerkats like furry little jacks-in-the-box!
They stand straight as sticks on their hind legs and scan the blue sky.
Underneath their sandy mound lies a maze of cool, twisty tunnels.
When everything is safe, they giggle, wrestle, and sun their tummies together.

w-sunny-savanna.name: Sunny Savanna
w-sunny-savanna.parentQuestion: Who lives in the tall golden grass?
w-sunny-savanna.galLine: Entirely peaceful herbivore savanna with zero scary predators; emphasizes social animal families, gentle grazers, and comforting open space.
w-sunny-savanna.parentNote:
The sun shines warm and bright across the wide golden grassland.
Gentle breezes sway the tall yellow grass while zebra friends graze peacefully.
A whole family of curious meerkats stands on tiptoes on their lookout hill.
Under the umbrella tree, a tall spotted giraffe nibbles the highest leaves.

w-acacia-grove.name: Tall Acacia Grove
w-acacia-grove.parentQuestion: How do the giraffes reach the high leaves?
w-acacia-grove.galLine: Giraffes are a primary preschool favorite for their sheer vertical scale; exploring canopy feeding and hanging nests teaches how tall trees support many different animal neighbors.
w-acacia-grove.parentNote:
The umbrella acacia spreads wide like a giant green parasol in the sunshine!
A mother giraffe and her tall calf stand tall on their long, graceful legs.
Their long purple tongues reach gently past tiny thorns to pick the sweetest leaves.
Hanging from the lower branches are cozy round nests woven from golden grass.

w-watering-hole.name: Savanna Watering Hole
w-watering-hole.parentQuestion: Who comes to drink at the pool?
w-watering-hole.galLine: A heartwarming community scene of animal families sharing water peacefully; water play, spraying trunks, and mud bubbles provide immense sensory joy.
w-watering-hole.parentNote:
Everyone gathers at the big round water pool for an afternoon drink!
A mother elephant uses her long, wrinkly trunk like a giant garden hose to shower her baby.
A gentle little zebra foal bends down low to take sweet, cool sips of water.
Over in the soft muddy shallows, a friendly round hippo wiggles its tiny pink ears.
